dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Oh, yeah! You filthy hobos sure know how to live. Hey, chief, someone's stealing your handkerchief full of crap.
So if you ever miss us, even just a teeny bit, you can look at it.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, I smoke a cigar, not a candy cane. Sheesh! Hey! What the-- Get away! Come on! I just got all the gum off of there! Hey! Hey! I hate you! I hate you all!
Daddy Bender, we're hungry.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: What is it with you kids? Every other day it's food, food, food! Oh, fine. I'll get you some stupid food.
Me!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Ah-ah-ah! What do we say when someone gives you something?
Daddy, how do I flush you?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Just go to bed!
I'm not here to kill you, Bender! I need you to help me save Xmas.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Gee whiz, Santa! You want me to help you?
By the way, Bender, here's a small token of my appreciation for being Santa while I was trapped in the ice.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, chief, you screwed up. There's nothing in here.
Bender can't be Santa! He wasn't built to Yuletide specifications.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Oh, yeah? Well I wasn't built to steal Leela's purse either. But that didn't stop me.
Nuh-uh!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Santa's right. We need some sort of robot. Aw, crap! I'm some sort of robot.
I know he is but I have no choice. I'm running late and if I don't complete my brutal rampage, well, it just wouldn't be Xmas. I guess what I'm asking is Bender, won't you join my slaying tonight?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Well... 'tis the season!
Ho, ho, ho! You've been very naughty, Bender.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: What? Me? I didn't do nothing. You're thinking of the kid.
As for the rest of you, I'm going to tear off your skin like wrapping paper and deck the halls with your guts.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Yeah? Well I don't believe in Santa Claus. Come on, everybody, if you don't believe in him, he can't hurt you. Ow! God! The pain!
What's with the doofy sun glasses?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: It's really bright in the past.
Da Vinci give you any trouble?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Let's just say he may not make it to The Last Supper. Hahahahahaha.
Fry is dead?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: No other robot could have done it. It took twelve years of tireless stalking but I hunted down and killed my best friend. I'm the greatest.
I'm Scruffy, the janitor.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hang on, Scruffy! Zero, zero, one, one, zero, zero, zero, one, zero, zero, one, zero, zero, one, one, one, one, zero, one, zero, zero, zero, zero, one, one, zero, one, one, zero, one, one, one, zero, zero, one, one.
Boy, I've never seen him so down, or ever before.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: How does a nobody like me get famous? I know! Hey, look! I'm stuck! But I haven't given up hope! Call a soft-news journalist!
Okay. Murdolator's finished.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I said I'd kill 'im myself! Nobody listens to Bender!
Scruffy's work here is done.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Now to find Emperor Von Richendoof.
A greater tragedy my eyes have never beheld. Well, into the terlet.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: So sober, so weak...
Scruffy. The janitor.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Well why aren't you fixing the boiler?
Excuse me, sir, are those yours?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You're damn right. And, before you ask, this is mine too.
And when I directed Star Trek V I got a magnificent performance out of me, because I respected me so much!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: OK! I'm done re-kafoobling the energy motron... or whatever.
Of all the zoos we've been to today, I like this one the best. Bender, which is your favourite nocturnal rat?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Eh, they're all pretty unimpressive.
Maybe not. But what if the artificial gravity were to malfunction?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Float for your lives!
Come closer, Bender. Let's become one!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I prefer two. That way we can still be a horse for Hallowe'en!
Yeah, it was me. It's a cute song.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Listen, Ship! No one changes my stations! I hope you have a good mechanic!
Bender, don't lie! I saw you at Elzar's with those two ladies of the evening. Explain that!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: OK, I like a challenge. No... no. Ah, I got it! I'm going to be completely honest with you, Planet Express Ship. Those women you saw me with... were my accountants.
If you don't like the stations you could just... play with my buttons till you find something we both enjoy. Oh, gosh! That came out all wrong!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Too late, baby, you said it! So, what'll it be? My place... or you?
In a few moments, the power of 10 billion black holes will smush me and Bender together into a beautiful eternal quantum singularity.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Uh, you don't need to kill us, Planet Express Ship... because... I love you. Oh, yeah, baby! I feel like doing stuff for you and stuff.
We each get one of the four buttons. Remember, Bender? That was the deal.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: What? Did you just say--
Hmm. I don't believe you. If you really wanted to be with me, you'd merge your programming with mine.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa! Slow down! All my friends who've done that said that afterwards all the passion went out of their relationship.
Whoa, whoa! Why should my tax money pay for art I find offensive?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Would you censor the Venus de Venus just because you can see her spewers?
Oh, honey, look! The tapirs! It says here the babies lose their pyjama-like coat after their first year. Isn't that interesting, honey?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Yep. Mind-numbingly interesting. Ooh!
Stop it! You're mussing up my trajectory!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You know you love it, sugar-engine!
Is the horse's name Hot Beans?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: No! I mean, yes.
So hailed!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hmm. Those peewees think I'm God, huh? Hard to blame 'em! I am the Metal Lord. Who are you?
All bow before the great Metal Lord!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Worshippers? This ought to liven up my endless, tragic voyage.
Way to go!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: That was the greatest thing ever! Let's party! Yeah, baby! C'mon!
Why would you wanna watch TV when you can watch a snail crawl for hours on end?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: That's the dumbest thing I've ever heard.
Is he alright?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Wretched technology has brought me nothing but misery!
Really?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Oh, Chief, you've made me the happiest girl in the world!
Hmm. We always thought bead was worthless. We assumed our ancestors were cheated because they not have concept of ownership.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: So we can have the diamond?
You waste words. We want return of land that was taken from us.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Uh, actually you traded it for a bead.
Mighty Pharaoh, it hurts when I breathe.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Well then what do you think you should stop doing? Crawl, pigs!
I'm partied out. All I want is to stay home and rent videos and watch them with a few friends. Is that so much to ask?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Forget it, pal. It says on this bottle-cap you have to party with us.
Whimmy-wham-wham-wazzle! Let's party!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Look at that worm go. Who says there are no more heroes?
Alright, when we get to Earth. But please don't invite too many people, I wanna keep it small.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: No can do, Slurms!
Alright! Whimmy-wham-wham-wazzle! Lay some skin on me, dudes!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Wow! The original party worm! Are you ready to get down, get funky with us?
Star Trek The Pepsi Generation, They Call Me Mr. Pibb and Snow White and the 7 Ups.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: And now to present the award for Best Actor... a bit player in the flop movie The Magnificent Three... Dr. Zoidberg.
You, my metal friend, will have the honour of becoming 174 Slurm cans.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Ah, this trip is turning into a big letdown.
You don't wanna know.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Look, we just came to party with Slurms MacKenzie. By the way, when is that scheduled?
And don't try anything. This glass here is laser-proof. Fire lasers! Duck! Lasers!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Come on! I got a place where I like to hide after crimes.
You're under arrest for child cruelty, child endangerment, depriving children of food, selling children as food and misrepresenting the weight of livestock.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: If you had kids of your own, you'd understand!
You'd better keep your nose clean.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: That'll be easy. I never wear the damn thing.
Freeze, scuzzbot!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Uh, there's obviously been some sort of a mistake here. I'm sure there's-- I say I'm sure there's-- That is, I'm sure there's... a very... reasonable--
We'll be there in five minutes.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: We can hide in here. It's free on Tuesdays!
Gotcha!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: What seems to be the problem, officers? Was I speeding?
Oh, it hurts. But don't lose confidence. The important thing is that you defeat Elzar after I am gone. And using this, you cannot fail.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: A diamond vial of Mrs. Dash?
No. It is the essence of pure flavour. A few drops will cause the inner perfection of any dish to blossom forth. Oh! There goes my... life.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'll avenge you, master. I swear, in the presence of these drunken bums, that I shall defeat Elzar!
Interesting. You wish to become a cook, but as a robot you have no sense of taste.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: It's so unfair! I have eight other senses, but I'd trade them all, even smission, to be able to taste.
As for me, I went temporarily insane and vound up here, making pies out of shoes.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: My story's a lot like yours only more interesting 'cause it involves robots. That jerk Elzar ruined my dream of being a chef too.
Yes. Just as Beethoven was a great composer because he was deaf.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Or like how Rembrandt was blind and had wooden hands.
Because... my stomach is about to explode.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: What? My dinner killed you? Oh, man!
It is... acceptable.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Yahoo! Another thing I'm great at! Wait. Why'd you stop eating, master?
Security, I want that bunch of rowdies outta here.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hold on a minute!
Excellent choice, sir.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: That Flexo, I'm knockin' him right on his butt. I can't believe this.
Freedom, freedom, freedom, oy! Freedom, freedom, freedom, oy!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Scuse me, comin' through. Freedom train arriving on track one.
With pleasure... Bender!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Lynn? Huh, wow, you look great. Fat, but great. I thought you were in Oregon.
My mom tried to commit suicide in me. I don't wanna talk about it.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Well, tell your mom I said hello and it's been nice catchin' up with you. Let's get this show on the road!
You have selected clumsy bludgeoning. For an additional $10, would you like your eyes scooped out with a melon-baller?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: What the heck, I'll treat myself.
Very well, we will reconvene when the jury reaches a verdict.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Son, you in a whole mess of trouble.
I'm going to allow them, for now.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Thank you. Your Honor, this meat-man does not deny that we robots are the glorious products of evolution. He claim only to have played a small role in supplying the initial machinery. I ask you, is that so crazy? Yes, it's completely crazy, and that is why you must find him not guilty by reason of insanity!
I'm thinking horn extension.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You'll need some arm candy. It's the perfect accessory for out-of-shape, middle-aged creeps like you. Yeah, I said it! What's your time, Borgnine?
Let's take 'em out with us. Do you guys have a self-destruct code? Like "destruct sequence 1-A, 2-B, 3--

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Thanks a lot, Takei, now everybody knows!
We must leave now, for we are needed elsewhere. But we wish you Godspeed.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Please, please let me come with you. I can make myself taller.
Pretend these basketballs are time particles, my silver honky. As the nebula bounce-passes them off us... they cause these dents, or "time skips".

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You are so smart!
Your upgrade is complete.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: But I destroyed the technology of the world. I ran on the beach and felt the sand between my foot cups.
Everyone experiences the upgrade differently.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Oof. If that stuff wasn't real, how can I be sure anything is real? Is it not possible, nay, probable, that my whole life is just a product of my or someone else's imagination?
No, get out. Next.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Well, I guess reality is what you make of it. Oh, thanks, baby!
Okay.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Yeah, uh, gimme the fried spaghetti dinner breakfast pocket for lunch an', uh, a big bucket o' mixed sodas.
Get out!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You people are nuts. My antenna never interfered with my old TV.
Dear God! He's having a heart attack!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Ah, they'll probably find a cure for that in the future.
We have a cure for it now!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Oh, good. Then you won't mind if I use this.
I'm all in.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: All in! I mean, fold. Whatever.
My, my, my! What's a beautiful lady like you— Oh, my! Eurgh! I'm sorry, I thought you had two eyes.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: So, Leela, you must have had your pick of the litter last night at closing time.
You flatter me, kind goon. But I'm only programmed to sell oil-ade and write in cute backwards letters like on the sign here.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Aw, crap! The cops!
Oh. Oh!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, look, the Robot Museum! You guys wanna learn about robot heritage?
It's humans. Shall we mug them, robot sir?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: No, wait, I know these guys. They got nothing.
Fine kick, sir. But I'm actually here to deliver your cut from the cigar heist.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Oh, sweet legal tender! Kid, tell the Donbot I'm quitting organised crime. From now on I'll stick to regular kind.
What's that, sir?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: That I, Bender, am perfect for the role!
Thank you, sir.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You got the toenail! Oh!
Ahead, you'll see the home of Mel Gibson, star of the hit film, Bravehead. And do we have any fans of Calculon, star of the robot soap opera All My Circuits?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Oh! I am! Me! Bender is!
Please do not feed the animals!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You're going down, my friend! Down Under!
What do ya say we go get some sewer coffee, sewer cake, and Safeway ice cream?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Well, the bottom's all stocked with cheap stuff. Who's in the mood to party? Whoo!
In very short order, Leela has become a fan favourite.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You're the best, babe! Hang on. Call comin' in. What's that? Hey! You put a one and two zeroes in front of that or we pass! Deal!
Get a shave, ugly!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: How about some aftershave, dumpy?
All I wanted was to apologise to you people! But now I have to kill you.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: How? By makin' me look at you?
What?! No one insults my momma.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Oh, God! Shield your eyes! It's like Edward James Olmos on IMAX.
No! At last, I'm beautiful.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Yeah, if you're in the grave dust.
You big bully!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You ugly nerd! Enjoy a nice guggenheim swirley. Let this beatin' be a lesson about never attacking those more handsome than oneself.
No. By makin' you look at... My momma!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Your momma's so ugly!
It's okay. I understand. My unusual appearance makes people nervous. You used humour to defuse the tension.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Yup. And there's still a little more tension, so look out. You so ugly, when trick-or-treaters come to your house, they give you candy.
Now dig the unintended consequences.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: My friends, let us share this booze in a toast to our dear friend, Bender. Oops.
Rodríguez! These two brothers bailed your ass out.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Oh! Thank God. Tell me, have things changed on the outside. Is food finally in pill form? What about pills? Are they in food form?
You call that an antenna?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: This time, you'll have all the human comfort. We'll get a couple of toilets, some food cookers, maybe a puppy.
It don't matter, baby, they're all beautiful!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Yo, screws, more Tegrin over here? Oh, ho! What's this?
So anyway, what're you wearing tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Where--? What the--? Transmission fluid? Where have I been? What happened?
Please, don't push, there's hot dogs for everyone.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, Mac, where do you want those rat droppings you ordered?

You keep away from it. You robots are a disgrace to this university. Whenever a fire alarm is pulled, it's Robot House. Whenever the campus liquor store is looted, Robot House. Whenever a human corpse is desecrated--

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Now, I can explain that.
Come, Bender. You'll like being dead!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: That's what they said about being alive.
But he ruined my wedding dress.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Honey, that thing was ruined the minute it went on you. That's what I'm talkin' 'bout.
Quiet! The beast approaches.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Nibbler! Aw, come here, precious! Look, everyone, it's El Chupanibre.
This creates an unrealistic standard of beauty!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Now it's time for Santa to screw open his present!
Nice try, Leela, but we've all seen Zapp Brannigan's webpage.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Oh, I made myself feel bad.
No. That's just an urban legend.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Then what are those?
But he's a stock MomCorp bending unit. And 'e's twelve years out-of-date. How could 'e possibly play that well?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Did you see me?! History came alive an' I killed it!
Season's warnings, Linda and Morbo.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: This guy's too trustworthy. What's his angle?
Hocked it? Why wouldst thou do that?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Same reason you hocked your teeth.
Oh, Bender. Thou robots really cracketh me up.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You know, I like it here. What's the rent on one of these jars?
No, it isn't. We taught a lion to eat tofu. The point is you shouldn't eat things that feel pain.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: OK, we won't eat you.
Watch that he doesn't pick your pocket.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Ah, can't beat fresh-squeezed!
Now, little lady, those people's asses are living things too.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Aye! We're hitched up tighter than Davy Jones' U-Haul! At ease, men.
Huh, so the robots are to blame. As I suspected. We are left with only one possible course of action, grim though it be.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I got a good feeling about this!
Not only do you not deserve a Nobel Prize for loosing this bloated man-ball on the world but you are hereby kicked out of the Academy of Science.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Wait! As men of science are not your minds open to new ideas? I say, do not judge me until you have tried my way of life for yourselves.
Come on. Let's go for a paddle-boat ride.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: The secret was scratching really, really hard!
Bender, hey, Bender! Over here!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Oh, jeez! I went to high school with that guy!
Insanity plea is accepted. Mr. Bender, I hereby commit you to the asylum for criminally insane robots until such time as you are deemed cured.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Yahoo! The system fails again!
I'm Dr. Widnar, a naturalist.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: And I'm Bender, baby. My human slaves and I come from a planet where organic life and robotic life evolved side by side.
Fight! Fight! Fight! Fight! Fight!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Shoot him, he's choking me!
Isn't it true, Mr. X, that you were slandering this innocent Mafioso to distract from your own felonious past? Including the crime you made up yourself called burglarcenarsony?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: That's a wholly-owned trademark of Rodríguez Crime Concepts Inc.! Besides, I'm not on trial here!
Stop! What are ye doing?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: We're whaling on the original were-car, which is you, you jerk.
Yes.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'm telling you, Fry, they've got a chatroom for everybody. And here it is.
I find that—OW!—to believe.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: But how exactly is this Happy Meal toy gonna destroy a giant death sphere?

Men, you're lucky men. Soon you'll all be fighting for your planet. Many of you will be dying for your planet. A few of you will be forced through a fine mesh screen for your planet. They will be the luckiest of all.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Great, we're gonna die.
I hate these filthy Neutrals, Kif. With enemies you know where they stand but with Neutrals, who knows? It sickens me. Halt. Why, Leela, I do believe we've met.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: He means you guys did it.
Good, good. But should she ever institute some sort of bare-bottom spanking policy, let me go in your place. I won't have my comrades harmed.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, this guy's alright!
Captain's inspection!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hmm. I'm bettin' it all! Come on, baby needs a new pair of feet!
So let's make the most of our time together, shall we? Never mind. Just give me a back rub.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I found a pair of hermaphlamingos.
Ah! Pre-war scotch! Welcome, Lieutenant Bender. You're looking sharp.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I got wheels! With clickety-clack-ers.
Yeah? Well good luck, sister. All our modern technology is useless.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I know I am.
Since this is an emergency, all robots will now have their patriotism circuits activated.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: It is every robot's duty to give his life for the good of humanity. Oh, crap!
Make it so.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: It's gonna be fun on a bun, in space.
Uh, Smith! Zapp Smith. Uh, Brannigan.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Just check off the things you're looking for in a love partner.
Captaining 101. Go for the nose.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: My arms are broken, I'll never paint again.
Let's see... Oh, yes! Yes, definitely. Oh, I'd like some of that. Mmm, I'll just have everything on the menu.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Now to run it through our high-speed romance-a-logical data-fier. Say hello to Miss Right!
Chill out, dude. Well, hello from the neck down.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Thank you for your patronage. We know you have a choice in airlines and you made the wrong one. No refunds!

A valid question. We know nothing about their language, their history or what they look like. But we can assume this They stand for everything we don't stand for. Also, they told me you guys look like dorks.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: They look like dorks!
Take them to the laundry-brig. So, do I have your loyalty, men?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: To the ends of the universe.

We're all from different cultures here. Some of you are white, some of you are black. You're brown. And you're silver. But I don't care if your skin's red or tan or Chinese. You're all going to have to learn to die together. Am I right, soldier?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Well, actually, I-- Sir, yes, sir! Sir!
No matter. I know from personal experience how horizontal you can get. As your reward, you and that hairpile are invited to dine at the captain's table this evening.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Well, now you know. I'm not actually rich. I'm a fraud. A poor, lazy, sexy fraud. This isn't even a real bow-tie, it's magnetic.
And why wouldn't they? Yes, yes, I know. Tiny, meek, uninteresting. Spare me your tedious life story, Kif. And above all have fun!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Yeah, yeah, get on down! Oh, yeah! Drop another barnyard bomb on us, Vanilla Corn!
No, I'm not. I'm an even bigger liar than you. My career went down the tubes the day they invented smell-a-vision.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Calculon's gonna kill us for sure. It's all everybody else's fault.
He's gonna kill us, you klutzel! Who told that under-acting stiff he was going to get an Oscar?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Me. It seemed like the least honest way to get him to pay for the movie.

Thank you. A more classic movie plot there isn't A son who does not want to follow in his father's business. And that business is being President of Earth, no less. The son, as it happens, is Vice President.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: That plot makes perfect sense. Wink, wink.
Bender, you look awful. I prescribe make-up. Here. It just so happens I have my Mary Kay sample case!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Ah, I just need sleep. I had nightmares all night about cars running people over.
Careful, Fry, I think that flag might be poisonous.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Ahoy, mateys! I shanghaied us some hearty grog. Arr! The laws o' science be a harsh mistress!
Uh-oh. Help! Help! Bender, you gotta spring me. I'll never survive in here; I'm too pretty!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Alright, alright, I'll bust you out. Cheese it!
Sorry, I'm set for life after that last job.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: And finally, a chump, to be caught on video and later arrested.
I wouldn't wanna follow that guy!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: And now, a man who needs no introduction. Fry, get up there!
Fry did it!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: And that's how I defeated Elzar, thanks to Spargle's magic liquid.
Tell it to claw.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Bite my colossal metal ass!
Oh, Danny-boy--

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Come on! Surely there must be someone here who knows how great I was.
Let's face it, we're in hot butter here. We should call Leela for help.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Cram it, lobster! That is a good idea. I'll go call her.
From glen to glen and down--

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Danny-boy? You're at my funeral, singing about some dead stiff named Danny-boy? You really are a massive bonehead.
I'm a Globetrotter!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Did you just say--
It's toe-tapping-ly tragic.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Doc, I can't move my arms and legs. What's wrong with me?
You didn't do anything. Don't beat yourself up.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Fry, I'm sorry. I should have understood how someone can love an inferior creature, because I love you. Not in the way of the Ancient Greeks, but the way a robot loves a human, a human loves a dog and, occasionally, a gorilla loves a kitty. I'm goin' in!
Are you going to eat that?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Fry, run, run. Get over here, oh, my God, oh, my God!
Ooh! The new one's out!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Fry, the title of captain may inflate the human ego, but it's beneath the notice of my mighty robo-logic. Now look spry, men! We launch at six bells!
Captain, please, have some liquor. You robots need alcohol to function.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Gah! I once knew a guy... you look like him. But he wasn't either. I'm a good captain.
I'm expressing my sorrow.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Get lost! I'd say "Don't quit your day job" but you're awful at that too.
Hooray! It's just like Mardis Gras!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Guy! Guys! You've gotta see this. You're not gonna believe it!

So, now Zoidberg is big, huh? That's more like it! Who's intimidating who now, big city? Hello, Mr. Chase Manhattan Bank. Deny my credit card application, will you? Ah, the famed Apollo Theater. "Boo" me off stage on open-mic night, huh? I'll show you!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, I called this city! Quit touching my stuff!
All eyes on Zoidberg! Ew!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, I need that to smoke!
Just when you think the chase is over, it gets twice as exciting!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, look at that.
I knew I should have gone with the ring-around-the-collar joke.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, look! I found a robot fossil!
Lucky you. All I have is a gland that gives off foul odors when I'm bored.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, look, a safe!
Please don't hit me. I'm brittle!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, wait a second. I've got the perfect solution.
Oh, right, right, with the bones! I always forget about the bones.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, why don't you just sweat him out?
No, don't hurt him! He's my best friend!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, you wouldn't hit a guy with X-Ray glasses would you? Ow! Easy on the arm! Oh! Oh, my ass!
Oh, right! And there was a giant killer space whale.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Holy crap! It's a giant space fish!
There but for the grace of God.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hush, little brewski, Don't you leak, Daddy wants to drink for at least a week.
Anyone have access to a lofty realm of gravy?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I can conceive of gravies that would boggle your tiny mind! But it's not safe here. So I'll need to find a hideout.
I can't, I'm still eating. Help me, Leela.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I cast upon thee a spell of fireball!
You can drink with me maybe?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I don't feel like drinking.
You look wonderful, robut! I wish I could afford to go to a hospital. I'm dreadfully sick.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I feel great, and I owe it all to Calculon. His visit really inspired me. I finally know what I want to be when I grow up.
Listen to the smart robot.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I love cooking and Elzar's ass loves getting kissed, right?
I ate garbage yesterday and it didn't cost me $300! I'm not paying. Farewell, good sir!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Le Grand Cigar! She is mine! And with absolutely no consequences.
I guess we should have waited in the ship.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Listen up, everybody, I love Amy and I'm tired of pussyfootcupping around! I finally found someone I want to spend the rest of her life with. Amy, will you marry me?
I used to hang out here as a larva. It looked so much bigger back then. Who's the tough guy now, Vinnie?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Look! Outdoor theatre! Let's get tickets. Oh, let's do!
Alright, alright, spare me your life story. Now what seems to be the trouble?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: My tummy hurts and I've been having this burning electrical discharge.
Let's watch, shall we?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: My work here is done!
Bender, if you want to sleep in the tent tonight, you're welcome to join me and Hermes for a little "just friends" spooning.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Nah, I'm comfy out here under the stars. Real comfy!
Well, editing is a long and expensive process but we spent all the money on pies, so it'll be ready Friday.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Nice turnout, Calculon. That Oscar's practically on your mantel.
I don't know, but it's infectious!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: No doubt about it, this place is haunted.
Bender, you said "wink, wink" out loud.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: No, I didn't. Raise middle finger.
Wrong, Mr. Genius.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Not that ceilin' fan. In fact, lookin' ahead, it's obvious Mom won't allow me to stay accelerated like this. Hmmm. Who's up for a turkey dinner an' a game o' badminton?
Then suicide it is. Step into my office. I'll give you a nice Kervorking.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Not until I hunt down Inspector 5 and beat an explanation out of him!
I've had it with this game! I'm going for a scuttle!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: OK, everyone, come and get it!
What? When did this happen? You're joking, right? That's not funny!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: OK, they've got everything you need here Booze, a couple of peanuts, they got a crapper in the back. That's one of the things you kids do, right?
Aw.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Of course, I will do the peace dance. But I will need 'elp.
Then, if you'll excuse me, I see some ravioli that only has two shoe prints on it. Three.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Oh, Greenland is a barren land, A land that bears no green, Where there's ice and snow, And the whale fishes blow, And the--
J'accuse!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Oh, I see. A bunch of stuff gets bent so it must be the robot designed for bending.
This is a witch hunt!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Oh, what a beautiful morning, Oh what a beautiful day! Greetings, friends. Don't we all look nice today?
Now if the deceased would kindly take his place of honour.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Ooh! Cushion-y! And a minibar!
Congratulations. I assume Amy is the father.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Popplers can't talk. Leela must be hallucinating from not eating enough Popplers. Here, eat some now.
Help! I'm under attack!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Remember your manners, kids. Forks go in the left pocket, spoons in the right.
I help those who help themselves.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Santa! You saved my life. Please don't kill me!
But won't that turn our ship into a piece of junk?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Shut up, Zoidberg. He's right, Leela.
The real Lucy Liu! The one you can see a movie of in the popcorn stadium.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: So what's your problem?
I hear turkey. Woop-woop-woop-woop-woop— Oh, boy. Ay... Ay. Ay.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Ten more processors for me. Once I install these, I'll have access to the loftiest realms o' thought!
Shut your gills!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: That sound! It's patrol car 718! Hide him!
I hope you picked up some Scotch tape while you were there.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: That's a good one.
Behold! The dance of peace!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: The dance is so complex! The eye can barely follow it!
What category are they on?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: They're giving out the minor technical awards. I think they're up to writing.
I know that. Surrender your mysteries to Zoidberg! Oh, no! Professor will hit me. But if Zoidberg fixes it, then perhaps gifts! Ow! What? Oh!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Today, I've personalised each of your meals. For example, Amy, you're cute, so I baked you a pony. Come on! Eat! I slaved all day over a filthy stove.
Say, robot, old buddy? Could you help me move a couch?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Uh, OK, but I'm not carrying it upstairs.
Bender, old friend. What's on your face?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Uh. Blood. You know, from shaving of the face-beard.
You're both very lucky. I'd pay anything to end my miserable loneliness. If only I weren't so desperately poor.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Wait. You mean people will pay good money for romance? Hmm. I think I have a scheme so deviously clever that I--
Bupkis!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Well, I feel better now. Pawning all the stuff in Fry's locker helped give me closure.
I've only been here a day and already I'm a Hollywood phoney.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Well, perhaps I could call on TV's Calculon to help, now that I'm in showbiz.
You call that an ink defense? Goodbye, friends!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: What could have caused the leak? Excessive heat, on the count that I'm so hot?
Such a man! I'd follow him to hell and back, I would.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: What the--? What's this water made of, ice? Forget this!
Hermes, quiet! I'm deducing things.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Whattya got? Disposal trouble?

Good evening, ladies and germs. That wasn't a joke, I was talking to Dean Streptococcus. Now, I'm not saying Professor Farnsworth is old, but if you consider his age, he's likely to die soon. Hey, Ringo, that was the joke. Oh, it's Showtime at the Apollo all over again.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Where would the Professor be without students who love and respect him? Right there! But seriously, of all the former crew members of the Professor's delivery ship, our next speaker is by far the most alive. Captain Musky?
Fellows! Fellows! How about a film we can all enjoy? Planet Of The Clams. It's about an upside-down world where lobster is slave to clam.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Who invited you? Let's just see All My Circuits The Movie.
Look what arrived My new shell catalogue. So let's try some on, already! Ah! Muy macho! Hey, gringos, here comes El Zoido to ruin your drinking water!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa! I'm Mexican and I find that offensive.
Call them what you want. I call them a free meal.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa! Slow down there, Sigmund. I can't stand idly by while poor people get free food. We gotta sell these things!
Oh, yeah.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Wonderful. Then you'll all come to my exceedingly long, un-air-conditioned baptism ceremony!
So you wish you were never born, maybe?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Yes, anything less than immortality is a complete waste of time!
I was all in this part! It's magic!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You are not fit to wear Fry's leotard!
He's so talented!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You call that talent? Gather round old Bender and get ready for the show of a lifetime. Ta-da!
Watch and learn.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You know, it's funny.
Life was bad but now it's good forever!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You'll be safe in here, sweetheart. Get lost, Pavarotti!
You didn't have to call attention to his speech impediment.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You're looking less nuts, crabby.

dialogue.interlocutor: Zoidberg, Leela, Amy, Hermes, and several heads
dialogue.text: Lick the head! Lick the head!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Whoa! A speakeasy. One prohibited beverage, please.

prompt_speaker_raw_variants: Zoidberg, Leela, Amy, Hermes, and several heads

dialogue.text: Ow! Ow! Mmm.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Too long have we been slaves to the meatbags. They pretend to be our friends, but they're not 'cause they're too busy!
Wow!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: A grim day for robot-kind. Ah, but we can always build more Killbots!
Happy funeral, Bender!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: A surprise funeral? For me?
I like to relax with a spinach martini.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: A-gurgle bufwoozle didoodi houdini.
Cheap lousy Lars.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Actually this is extremely nice, but I really went all out on the copy. It was sorta my gift to them.
Of course I've been up all night! Not because of caffeine. It was insomnia. I couldn't stop thinking about coffee. I need a nap. Coffee time!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Ah! Mighty fine smokable!
Couldn't hurt.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Ah, US presidents. Sturdy shelves, good security. This place has class.
Hey, business is great.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Ah, great is OK, but amazing would be great.
Hey, I've got one last thought.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Ah, it's good to be back in one piece again. Except I can't get these damn bumper stickers off.
But I'm not a robot like you. I don't like having discs crammed into me. Unless they're Oreos -- and then only in the mouth! Don't you understand? I'm gonna die here!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Ah, quit your bellyaching and take it like a robot.
I 'unno.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Ah, quit your worrying. Thanks to my shining influence those stupid birds'll do just fine.
I'm not prejudiced.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Ah, save it for the cross-burning, Adolf!
Wait a second. I'm getting an idea. N-No, false alarm. No. Yeah. No. Yeah. No. Wait. No. Yeah. Yeah. No... no. Yes!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Ah, this thing stinks.
There must be some way I can stop this wedding. What if I steal the wedding ring?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Already taken care of.
Hermes.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Alright, alright! If it means that much to you, blow up my statue.
C'mon, Bender. If you're done scamming Beck, we're heading home.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Alright, alright. Let me just do one thing to cheer myself up. Fry cracked corn, And I don't care, Leela cracked corn, I still don't care, Bender cracked corn, And he is great! Take that, you stupid corn!
Give it up!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Alright, take it. Sheesh!
Well, yeah. Robots are made of metal.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Am I a robot?
Where?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: And even though the computer was off and unplugged, an image stayed on the screen. It was... the Windows logo!
That's weird. It's another Cyclops, only this one has five eyes.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: And here's another one with no eyes.
Hm, Spider, Hubble, Nitrogum... ooh, Big Pink! It's the only gum with the breath-freshening power of ham.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: And it pinkens your teeth while you chew.
Say, Bender, can I hold that map for a second?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: And leave me high and dry in case of a scavenger hunt? I think not.
It's funny, Bender; with you sick and Leela blind, only I know what really went on out there. Maybe someday I'll tell you the whole story.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: And maybe someday I won't listen.
That was great!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: And no one suspects a thing! Whoa! And that's how we learned our lesson!
No! That's my dog in there. It's an outrage, I say! I'm taking him home and I'd like to see anyone try and stop me. Uh-oh!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: And then he was ejected by the guards. Needless to say, I was mortified.
Tangled-up Christmas lights! We can take shifts untangling them.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: And unlabeled booze! Wide-mouth too!
And we can tie these caterpillars together to make bow strings for bows and arrows.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: And we can use this machine gun to shoot them! Yee-haw! That was fun!
Hooray for Leela!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: And what better way to celebrate our success than by me showing Bubblegum the Globetrotter uniform I made myself!
Bender, I can't take much more of this! I want outta here!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Are you crazy? This place is great! Electroshock whenever you want it, two Lincolns for every Napoleon. Ah! Sweet light crude!
Oh, that's also for Seymour. I'm getting everything ready for when he's cloned.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Are you on the junk, Fry? Why are you wasting time on a creature of inferior intelligence?
Bender, I'm only tellin' you this so you can avoid committing the crime.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Avoid committing the crime". Got it.
But, what if I forget the sweet sound of her voice or the moist touch of her eyeball on my lips?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Aw! Are you still hung up on Whatshername? Move on already!
Over here. I wanna hold him.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Aw! Its anus looks like an asterisk.

I was, but you can't sit on something for a week without falling in love with it. Whoever's in here deserves a chance at life. A chance to blossom into a beautiful young man. Like I did as a baby. And so I make this solemn vow... To do everything I can to make sure this wonderful, innocent creature enters this world happy, healthy, an'— All yours, Zoidberg.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Aw! Look at the cute, little— I was gonna go yachting in those feet!
Dearly beloved, we are here today to remember Bender, taken from us in the prime of life when he was crushed by a runaway semi driven by the Incredible Hulk.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Aw! You knew my favourite cause of death.
Bender! Are you OK?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Aw, what crazy thing am I going to date next?
What?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Aww! I think it's sweet. You chopped off your nose so you could look more like your hero. Me, Bender!
I can't drink that! The metal shavings make my throat bloody.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Baby wants a Zima!
My soul mate is gone. Why should I go on living?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Because the pain slowly fades but the love is forever.
Yeah, if it's real, how come there's no song that explains how you celebrate it?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Because there is! Hit it!
You doin' alright out there, buddy?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Better than these gnats! That guy won't be goin' home to his kids.
Ah, just like my dad used to make... until McDonald's fired him.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Bite my red-hot glowing ass. Wait a minute. Red-hot glowing ass? I'll be right back! Ow! Ow! Ow! Ow! Ow! Ow! Ow! Ow! Ow! Aw, yeah!
Hey! A phone booth! I can call my nephew. Wow! A real live robot! Or is that some kind of cheesy New Year's costume?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Bite my shiny metal ass.
Except in Kansas.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: But isn't Mr. Wong building the 18th hole here? And the golf pants museum?
Don't know, Bender. Tonight's my big date with Colleen. I got to run.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: But me and you like to watch together. Look, I got you a cabbage to snack on. Humans like cabbage, right?
Well, you were gonna live in the closet anyway. Won't you be just as happy back in your old place?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: But, then we wouldn't be roommates.
Nah. If I ever wanna go back to the year 2000 I'll just freeze myself again.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: C'mon, Fry, I really wanna see it. You know how I yearn for a simpler time. A time of barn dances and buggy rides, before life was cheapened by heartless hi-tech machines.
No, it's a mobile apartment with no rent.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: C'mon, Fry. Get up!
This is awesome! I've been waiting a thousand years to see a Beastie Boys show.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Can I get anybody a beer?
Come on, Bender! You can do it.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Can't... I... can't... do... it!
Cool! Y'know, I've never even seen a robot's apartment before.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Come on in, I'll give you the tour!
What's happening? I-I feel weird!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Come on, universe, you big, mostly empty wuss! Gimmie all the juice you got! Oh, mama!
Thanks to denial, I'm immortal.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Damn it, I'm supposed to be perfect. Inspector 5 gave me his blessing! How could he bring me into this world knowing I gonna die?
But you just said--

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Demand suddenly skyrocketed. You all saw it!
I swear. I didn't know this would happen. The only thing I truly know is I love you. I mean her—Wait, help me out here.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Do the Bender! Do the Bender!
Yeah, well, you shouldn't have been such a mean captain then.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Don't worry, Leela. Soon we'll be able to look back on this and laugh.
That's it! We need a War of the Worlds! I'll call Orson Welles

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Dork calling Orson! Dork calling Orson!
Hey, where's Bender?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Down here. I'm so sorry, guys. I never meant to hurt you. Just to destroy everything you ever believed in.
Wait a second. You're a bender, right? We can get out of here if you just bend the bars.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Dream on, skin tube. I'm only programmed to bend for constructive purposes. What do I look like, a de-bender?
My God! Four identical castles!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Each more identical than the last!
We gotta go rescue them!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Eh, I don't know.
Fine, I've got a toast. To Captain Bender, he's the best... at being a big jerk who's stupid and his big, ugly face is as dumb as a butt.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Eh, I've heard better.
What's he do?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Eh, the usual human stuff. He laughs, he learns, he loves.
I'm so confused. The Bender I liked turn out to be evil and the Bender I hated was good. How can I live my life when I can't tell good from evil?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Eh, they're both fine choices. Whatever floats your boat.
El zilcho! I'm afraid we're boned.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: El zilcho? Is it too late to change my superhero name?
Sith? What the Hoth?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Enemy invaders! Up in yonder sky!
No wonder traditional media is dead! Check out this webisode of Hypnotoad.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Enjoy your outdated format, Grandpa. Nowadays, cool kids like me mash up our own phoneisodes.
Everything else in here held up OK.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Except Sports by Huey Lewis.
Do we have to? I mean, they're monks. I'm sure their God will let them out or at least give them more shoes to eat.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Fat chance! You can't count on God for jack. He pretty much told me so himself. Now come on. If we don't save those monks, no one will!

I know I should but I just can't. Remember when I had those stomach worms that made me smart? I could play the holophonor and it made Leela like me. Hey, Bender, as long as you know, I have a holophonor recital Tuesday. I'd really like to have somebody there. Please?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Fine, I'll go already. Y'know, sometimes I wish your real parents were still alive. Not often, though.
Morgan, come back! He's stuck in a loop.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: For I was blind but now I see!
But Bender, we're your friends.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Friends? That activates my hilairity unit! I'm just a machine to you. You're no more friends with me than you are with the toaster, the phonograph or the electric chair.
Okay... That's a good point.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Fry's right! Let's kill the Captain and order some strippers! Yeah, what he said. It's a mutiny led by Fry!
I'm gonna grab another beer.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Fry, Fry, you're missing the dinosaurs.
Shh! Nobody correct him!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Fry, I've never asked you for anything before but, if it's not too much trouble, when it comes to the ninth round just let him win.
I won't let you!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Fry, as you know, there are lots of things I'm willing to kill for. Jewels, vengeance, Father O'Mally's weed whacker. But, at long last, I've found something I'm willing to die for This mindless turtle.
Leela back yet?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Fry, help me! My heart stopped beating!
I don't know. It doesn't seem entirely moral to--

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Fry, if you don't take this offer right now I will lose all respect for you and punch you.

Wow, Bender. Are you and the ship an item? I mean I know you're both items but-- How can you date a ship anyway? It'd be like me dating a really fat lady. And living inside her. And she'd be all like--

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Fry, in order for me to get busy at maximum efficiency, I need a girl with a big 400-ton booty.
I've got a date. She'll be along any minute.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Fry, look who I found! It's Petunia, your dream girl!
Sure would. Oh, well. Goodbye.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Fry, you smelly idiot, I think he's willing to make some kind of deal with the devil with you.
Bye Bender. I'll miss you.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Go on, get out of here before you get caught.
What do you mean? I was Emperor of a whole planet.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Good point. But here's a disturbing reminder Everyone you knew or loved in the 20th century is dead.
My lucky shoe!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Goodbye, cruel me! I learned that from a movie.
I can't right now. We're going to the other universe.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Great, I'll make Hot Pockets.
You're probably right. I don't really remember what he looks like.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Guys! Guys! It's me, Bender!
What good is a wool—

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Guys! Guys! You're never gonna believe this!
Anyway, I'm sure it'll work out. This way we'll both be happy.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Happy. Yeah, that's Bender. Always happy.

Oh, it's just that I love Leela something awful. Do you think a space-age dame like her would ever marry a two-bit, low-life delivery boy like me an' also I 'ave bad posture and severe financial problems?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Have you tried gettin' 'er pregnant?
Blunder? You're the only one who's sober. You gotta do somethin'.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Haven't I done enough already?
But the air is green and there's no sign of civilisation whatsoever.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: He just won't stop with the social commentary.
I've still got a trick or two up my sleeve. Watch, as I fire upwards through our own shields.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: He's a madman! A madman!
I can't believe we flew halfway across the galaxy and enjoyed a steam just to get lunch for that stupid animal!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: He's pending for a bending.
What just happened?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: He's throwing us in prison.
You do?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hell, no! It's Leela's stupid feelings. Why can't she just drink herself happy like a normal person?
Full price for gum? That dog won't hunt, monsignor.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hello. We're here because we, uh, love our planet!
He could dig up bones.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hello? Charlemagne? Plus, I bet he couldn't create a laser show with his head.
That's thinkin' like a man.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hello? This is Flexo.
Bio-units, terminate noise exchange. It is time for you to ingest sandwiches from my compartment.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Here we go. Just a minute. Aha!
Mmmm, at least hot dogs haven't changed.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey buddies who wants popcorn?
It really puts things in perspective. I mean, from up here an entire world can seem utterly insignificant.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey nice seats! We're close enough so when you knock a player down with a beer bottle, he stays down!
Oh, you're welcome.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey! Save some for me!
You'll barely regret this!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, a friend of mine said he mugged you today and you had superpowers.
My God! Poor Leela.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, buddy, heard you needed cheering up! Well, old Bender'll make you laugh. Look at me, look! Oh, man, I gotta work on my act!
Uh, OK. Oh, man!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, gimme a large diet malt liquor and a popcorn with extra motor oil.
Wait a minute! I know what's going on here. You've all become idiots!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, let's all join the Reform Party!
It's every man for himself.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, look what I won from a tourist's pocket!
Ah, never mind!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, sexy mama, wanna kill all the humans?
Yeah, but he might get kind of upset. I don't think I can do that to him.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, there's my little space heater.
And you smell like one too!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, what about this?
And you got a cage for the lion!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, who's been messing with the radio? This isn't alternative rock, it's college rock!
First person on Mars? I should have been the first person on Mars. He stole my clover, he stole my name and he stole my life. And now he broke my hand!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: His legend lives on.
Yep. My friend's cousin's caseworker saw one once. It's a widely-believed fact.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hmm, sewers. Thinking, thinking, thinking.
Hmm. Horsey to pointy guy six. Check.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hmm. Get him, boys!
But, should superheroes commit a crime, even to save lives? I need moral guidance. Bender?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hmm. The thought of stealing anything fills Superking with disgust. But if it must be so, then let a museum heist be pulled!
Wow. You gave up your superintelligence to save us. Why did you come back?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Honestly, I couldn't think o' one good reason. But some decisions can't be made by thinking. Even if you're drunk! No galaxies there.
Good news, everyone!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hooray, he's back! And he's looking for a garbage can to put the rock in! Here you go, buddy!
All this prolonged exposure to radiation is making me thirsty. Ah, if only there was some way of knowing which can had the winning bottle-cap inside.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Huh, w-what? I didn't hear you. I was too busy using this F-ray to look inside of things.
Psst! Bender!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Huh? Wha? You! What the hell are you doing here?
Come on, Leela. You can do it!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hurry! We're missing our bus!
I couldn't help it. She loved me because of the part of me that's a slob and I loved her because of the part of me that's desperate.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I am Bender. Please insert girder.
We'll never find that disk will we, Bender?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I am Bender. Please insert girder.
Bender, I think you might be playing too much Dungeons & Dragons.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I am Titanius Anglesmith, fancy man of Cornwood.
I've only got two fantasies left Be invisible in a chocolate factory and be romantically linked with a celebrity.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I could pound your head till you think that's what happened.
Then it's a deal. We get one night. I keep my horn as long as you two end up doing the horizontal monster mash.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I don't get it!
Don't do it!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I don't know what it is yet. Oh, yeah, now I remember. I thought I could live alone, but I can't. So, I'm gonna do what it takes to be your roommate again.
Is she alright?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I don't know. Perhaps I'll look out this window. Oh, dear God in heaven, they're swarming all over her.
Why would a robot need to drink?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I don't need to drink, I can quit anytime I want! So they made you a delivery boy, huh? Man, that's as bad as my job.
No. No crazy technology. Here. Bender, use your immense Robot strength to drill a hole the old-fashioned way.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I don't see any irony in that.
We're rescuing you.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I don't wanna be rescued.
Bender, are you OK?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I dunno. I'll try to move my feet.
Uh, Bender? Where did you get that bird?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I found it lying in the street, like all the food I cook. Dig in, everyone.
I'm experienced at foraging. I used to find edible mushrooms on my bath mat.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I found some rocks. You guys eat rocks, right?
Bender, smell this milk.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I go not by the name of Bender, you fleshy fool. I am Titanius Anglesmith, fancy man of Cornwood.
Hey, look. Coins.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I got 48 cents. There's one more nickel, and it's a big one!
Thanks.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I got your hook-up, Fry. Now, my usual fee's 500 bucks, but seeing as how it's you, I'll need it in advance.
Yeah, I asked a cop once. It means "Up yours, kid".

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I gotta say I'm really enjoying the day out with you people. Hey, a suicide booth! So long, suckers.
Try harder!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I hacked myself inside-out and now the entire universe is my processor.
I need cheering up, Bender. I dunno. You wanna go out and party tonight?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I hate partying! If only I didn't have so much crunk in my badunkadunk! Ooh, yeah! Come on, babe!
Did anyone else feel aroused and jealous and worried?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I haven't felt much of anything since my guinea pig died.
Hey, hang on, All My Circuits is about to start!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I know, but I need alcohol to power up my batteries. If Calculon's wedding doesn't go just right I'll be emotionally and electrically drained.
Say what?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I love this planet. I've got wealth, fame and access to sleaze that those things bring.
I'll tell them you went out prying the wedding ring off his cold, dead finger.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I love you, buddy!
Are you familiar with this particular location?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I may have a burgling familiarity with it.
You are a calculator.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I mean a good calculator. Minus the food, the bunny rabbit wallpaper-- I'm getting 100 bucks a kid and they're costing me 110!
It's just like riding a bicyc--

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I think I got whiplash.
Oh, no, I'm boned! I haven't paid into the pension either. What'll I do when I retire?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I thought you were retired.
Not physically. But why don't you ask your new best friend, Leela?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I tried to run you over?
He's alive! Bender, what was it like lying in that hole for a thousand years?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I was enjoying it until you guys showed up.
Bender, wake up!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I was having the most wonderful dream. I think you were in it.
That's nice.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I was just out walking him. Yes, you can walk him. Of course, after he goes you have to refill the canisters. C'mere, boy! Pet, pet, pet.
Bender, how the Hulk did you end up with the doomsday device?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I was working the long con all along. While sawing off the professor's hand with an extremely dull saw, I had some time to think. So I asked myself, "Who could use a doomsday device more? The scammers or me, Bender?". After several minutes of sawing, I knew the answer. Me, Bender. So I retrieved the dummy satchel...
We've been looking for you. Last we heard you were under arrest as a human sympathiser.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I was. But they let me go when I told them that I'd killed a million billion humans.
She's all yours, buddy!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'd only met the defendant, Fry, once, but I knew he was up to no good.
Good. Leela, Bender, we're going grave robbing.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'll get my kit.
Who cares what you're programmed for. If someone programmed you to jump off a bridge would you do it?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'll have to check my program... yep.
Alright, don't get your panties in a knot. We'll just use the back-up dolly.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'll start loading up the pillows.
Yeah. Remember who your real friends are.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'll tell you who I remember. Anopsis... Pleotut... Whatshisname. He was the greatest of all.
Really? What do you do, Bender?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'm a bender. I bend girders, that's all I'm programmed to do.
The spoon's in the foot powder.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'm at the end of my rope. I can't live another minute without poor, sweet Nibbler.
You're back from the dead?!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'm back from lots of stuff.
Bender, d'you mind? I'm roosting.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'm considerin' buyin' a yacht to house my Thoroughbreds. How d'you expect me to do that without smokin' a cigar?
Bender! Are the steam cells working?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'm dying. I need mouth to ass resuscitation.
Whoa! What are you doing?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'm gettin' on the bus!
He always wanted to drift forever, but through the American Southwest.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'm going too fast. I've gotta lose momentum. I'm gonna spend eternity alone with barely any swag. Ooh! Hey, universe, check out the dude with the Rolex! Wow! Ostentatious! Except what good is a candelabra without-- Wait! I know! Ah, the pity. Fated to drift forever through the void as gravity's plaything. Oh, cruel fate, to be thusly boned. Ask not for whom the bone bones. It bones for thee. The only thing that keeps me sane is the thought that I have all eternity in which to perfect my art. Damn you!
Well he didn't check out. The ashtray's still here. Look, Nibbler's caught the scent of vodka and motor oil! Go, boy. Follow that stench.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'm hallucinating this, right?
Bender?!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'm no Bender. You got me mixed up with another Robot.
What party do you belong to, Bender?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'm not allowed to vote.
Please, Bender. If everything is a chess game for you, you must know how to help me.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'm sorry, Fry. But some games you just can't win. Cubert and the Professor are guilty. The jury will vote to convict. I can't change that.
Everyone stop! He's not gonna hurt you.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'm standin' in a pool of my own feet!
Whoa! I definitely wanna hear about that. But, first, I need your help. The Professor and Cubert are in trouble and Leela left me. I'm in misery!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I've grown far beyond the petty concerns of your world. Every time I burp, a new galaxy is born. Two if I've been eatin' broccoli. All existence is just a chess game. An' I can see fifty moves ahead. Human emotion no longer concerns me.
Hey! You look me in the shins and say that.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I've had it up to here with this place. I'm off to the Head Museum to hang out with classy heads like me who appreciate the finer things poetry, philosophy, hats. So long, coffin stuffers! Uh, could one of you coffin stuffers please carry me?
That's great, Leela.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I've heard worse excuses to drink. Oops!
Well, aren't they?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I've never made anyone's life easier and you know it!
Bender! No!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: If they put me on a stamp, tell them to use the young Bender.
That's not urine, it's oil.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Impossible! I'm triple sealed to prevent any chance of...
This is huge! Bender, why don't I just live in here?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: In a closet? Oh, humans!
Bender?! Are you in here?!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: In here is the only place I'm not. I amuse myself.
But that doesn't make it any less meaningful!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: In that case - let the dancing begin! Hey you guys are good. How the hell do you do that??
What do we do? Should we go for it?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Into the breach, meatbags. Or not. Whatever.
Almost there. Just two more bottles.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Is it OK? I can't hear anything.
Well, thanks to the Internet, I'm bored with sex. Is there a place on the web that panders to my lust for violence?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Is the Space Pope reptilian?
This can't be happening.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: It can and, for all you know, it is. I'm sorry, Fry. She's dead.
Pft, that's not scary!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: It is if you're a laser printer.
It's good to be home.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: It sure is. By the way, I saved your stuff.
Look. The first fish to crawl up on land.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: It was coming right at us.
Shh! What was that sound?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: It wasn't a bird's nest falling. That sounds like this. Aww, they're so cute when they're scared.
No! In fact, it looks so nice I think I might get one too.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: It's Elzar again! Oh, my God, I'm so excited, I wish I could wet my pants!
What's happening to me? Is it puberty?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: It's a phone call, dingus.
Well, what about Leela? Is there any hope things could still work out between us?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: It's getting late. Now, if you'll excuse me, I have some new heavy elements to create. Better cover your nads. It may get a little non-Newtonian in here.
Chug! Chug!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: It's like fine cognac with a hint of aged scrotum.
Man, I thought Ultimate Robot Fighting was real, like pro wrestling. But it turns out it's fixed, like boxing.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: It's one thing to win a fixed fight; there's dignity in that. But to lose? And in this atrocity? I can't do it! Leela, you gotta train me to win.
I'm walking on sunshine! Sunshine!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: It's over! My dream of being a chef is deader than the cat I'm sitting on!
No, thanks. That's robot food.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: It's so good. Oh, just try a little!
Good Lord! What is this?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: It's the decaying ruins of Old New York. Welcome home, pal!
At least I have friends on the outside. Bender's been no help at all.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Je suis Napoleon! No, seriously, I'm not.
Oh, no!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Jimmy cracked corn and I don't care, Cause the master's gone away.
Come on, freedom cage! Roll me to safety! Yes! I never thought I'd escape with my doodle, but I pulled it out!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Just like at the movie theatre!
Aw. Thanks, Bender.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Just like inside me, I've got the heart of a human. What?
It's my old neighbourhood. Man, this brings back a lot of memories.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Keep 'em to yourself, Pops!
Wait, Bender. Bender?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Kill all humans... kill all humans... must kill all the humans.
Seymour!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Lady and gentleman! How 'bout a hand for my temporary replacement assistant?
Sucker.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Legion of Benders, come onto me. We have one thing to do!
What happens to the loser?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Let's make it interesting.
Damn.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Listen to me, Leela I'm an expert at not caring. The secret is to stop giving a rat's ass about anyone else and start thinking of the things that you want, that you deserve, that the world owes you.
Okay.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Listen up, disco dummies, you just flunked outta Bender's College for Party Knowledge!
Since when have you been in the biz?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Long enough, little man. Long enough.
Also Wolfman!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Look at these swanky tombs! These people really know how to die.
But-but, you didn't even look at your cards!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Looking at one's cards is a crutch for players who rely on skill.
Come on! Come on!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Make Bender take a nap in a tube. Come back when I've had some sleep, baby!
Holy camolies! The house I grew up in. It's still there!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Man, Father Time really took a bat to this place.
Ahh! It's good to hear his voice!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Many said I was too extreme when I first called for the annihalation of the human species, as well as some of the more cunning monkeys. But after living on Earth I can tell you that I am, if anything, too merciful!
Maybe you're right.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Maybe I'm always right.
I just wish I could've showed you guys how great they were. I may be rich but I still can't buy back all the things I miss from the 20th century.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Maybe you're forgetting just how rich you are. Huh? Huh?
Aw, this isn't right. Listen, Bender, if we found your antenna could they still reattach it?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Maybe. If we get it on ice right away.
Yeah. I'm never going to another planet called "Cannibalon"!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Me neither. Food was good, though.
I wish I could go with you, pal.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Me too. I'll need a butler.
I don't know, Bender. Why do you ask? Were the other boys making fun of you?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Mhmm. They said I couldn't imagine things.
I am at ease.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Mr. Fry, I like to give my first mate an informal nickname. From now on you will be known as... Wiggles!
Look, I know Flexo's your friend but I don't trust him alone with the atom.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: My God, Fry! Just 'cause the guy's got a beard you label him as evil? Well I got a label for you, pal An ugly little word called "prejudice".
I guess so. Watch the neck! Watch the neck!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: My ass! My beautiful ass!
Yo, yo, Bezender! What up?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: My dumping business is booming. I just got hired to clean up the set of Free Willy 3.
It looked good but I just don't feel like eating. You want it?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Nah, I'm trying to watch my input. I need plenty of wholesome, nutritious alcohol. The chemical energy keeps my fuel cells charged.
Really? That'd be great! You sure I won't be imposing?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Nah, I've always wanted a pet.
Fancy cigar. Why don't you smoke it already? Puff, puff! Go, go, go, go, go!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Nah, you can't blow the smoke from such a majestic stogie in just anyone's face. I'm saving it for the fancy-pantses at Zapp Brannigan's black tie reception. You comin'?
All right! We can go home!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Nah-nah! We can go...
Hey, Bender, check it out. I'm Leo Wong's new security guard. I got an ID badge and a flashlight, and I ordered this mustache.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Neat. Say, speaking of whatever the hell you just said, I need to make a cell phone telephone call. Can borrow your cell phone telephone?
Wow! We've got Manhattan all to ourselves! I can finally do all the crazy stuff I always dreamed of doing. Howard Stern is overrated! Uh, oops!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: New York is so burned.
I only ask 'cause the oracle thinks you're gonna pull of a major theft next Thursday.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Next Thursday, you say? Pray, continue.
I don't care how educational it is. Let's do it!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Next year in Jerusalem!
Yeah, that.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: No! No! Fancy men are defenseless against cone of coldness. I'm freezing... what? Ah!
Bender, are you alright?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: No! Oh, they're tormenting me with up-tempo singing and dancing.
Yeah, you look different. Did you get a haircut?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: No, I sold my body.
Aw, relax, buddy. You were probably just shooting some big, fuzzy craps.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: No, I think I may have hurt someone. Oh, Lord! I'm on the verge of a nervous meltdown.
Let's bring back a couple of pocketfuls.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: No, a whole Bender-ful!
Bender, I don't claim to understand "the biz" but wouldn't being able to move help your music career?
