dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: No, don't you see? I was a hero to broken robots 'cause I was one of them. But how can I sing about being damaged if I'm not? That's like Christina Aguilera singing in Spanish. Wait, that's it! I'll fake it!
Bender, you did it!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: No, we did it. Ladies and gentlemen, if together we were able to defeat this giant space monster, think how also we might defeat the monsters of poverty and disease and unliteracy. In this spirit, I ask my fellow Benders to join me in working diligently to—
Oh, no! Any sign of Leela or Amy?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: No. But what do you make of this?
Did someone call me?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: No. Fry? But... I killed you in 2012. Unless...
Wait! We could hide you. We'll pile fruit on you and claim you're a bowl.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: No. I'm going to the party.
Hey, why are those kids following you? Do you have candy stuck to your ass?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: No. It's called "parenting". Come on, dumplings. We've got 12 government stipends to collect.
So let me get this straight This planet is completely uninhabited?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: No. It's inhabited by robots!
A little. You OK, Bender?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: None of your business! Get off my back!
You think that'll be enough to stop the ceremony.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Nope. I pulled the old switcheroo, so they won't even know the difference. Wait a minute, I think the copy I made cost more than this.
I'm sorry, Bender, but there's just not enough room.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Not enough room? My place is two cubic metres and we only take up 1.5 cubic metres. We've got room for a-whole-nother two-thirds of a person.
What's wrong?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Nothing. I guess I'm just going to have to get used to being half a robot.
Like the Kardashians.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Now they drank my booze?! They've gone too far!
That is entirely not true, sir!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Now to go switch bodies with Zoidberg, sneak past the metal detector and clip the alarm wires, all in less than... Ten minutes ago! Oh! Uh, could you come back when my chump gets here?
It's okay. They're not going anywhere. Where'd they go?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Now what's going on there?
Really? Whew! That's a load off my toad.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Now, if you'll excuse me. I'm off to slay the werewolf of Goblin Mountain.
So? What if something heavy fell on you, like a church? You could still die.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Nuh-uh! My wireless back-up unit saves a copy of me every day. So, if my body gets killed, big whoop, I just download into another body. I'm immortal, baby!
These things happen.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: OK, Fry, grab a Kleenex for this one, 'cause there's no God and your idiotic human ideals are laughable!
Yeah. Either that or be a man.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: OK, I've constructed an elaborate lie I'll call Angle-ine while pretending to be Flexo, arrange a date, show up disguised as him and catch her two-timing me with myself.
Bender, if you don't open that can right now, your fear will own you, and nothing that can opener could ever do would be worse than that.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: OK, OK, I can do this. It's time to take life by the cans.
Hurry, Bender. Get the bra!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: OK, fan. Just hold still and let me get-- Whoa!
Oh, Bender. You didn't touch the Crushinator, did you?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Of course not. A lady that fine you gotta romance first.
Or maybe, he never left at all! Wait a minute. You're Bender.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Of course, who said I wasn't?
Thanks.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Oh! FYI, I dropped that Tetris piece in the wrong place and ended the game.
Sorry, Zoidberg. I'm trying to join the country club.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Oh, Fry! I'll miss you!
Stop rubbing it in!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Oh, God! Fry, I'm so glad to see you. I didn't hurt you, did I?
Also, my shoe that fell off.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Oh, God. We're all gonna die in agony.
Oh, no! Poor Bender.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Oh, I don't feel good.
Granted. We can't take off without our captain.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Oh, and bring my toboggan.
That could be my beautiful soul sitting naked on her couch if I could just learn to play this stupid thing.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Oh, but you can. Though you may have to metaphorically make a "deal with the devil". And by "devil" I mean "Robot Devil". And by "metaphorically" I mean "get your coat".
Bender, you can move! You're cured!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Oh, crap! It's a miracle!
I'll show you. Whup.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Oh, it's a turnstile.
No, you have a healthy glow.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Oh, my God! I just felt it ferment!
Hurry! The Golden Gate Bridge! Put the metal to the pedal to the other metal.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Oh, no! I forgot this is a hoverbridge.
Hey, Leela, you know who I remember?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Oh, please, let it be me.
But it's a fight to the death!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Oh, so this is suddenly all about you. Sheesh!
I can hit a fish between the eyes from 20 yards!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Oh, yeah? I can hit a shrimp!
This contest is as good as over. I once caught a fish this big.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Oh, yeah? I once caught a fish this big!
Bender, no! You don't have to do something just 'cause it's gonna happen! The future's making a chump outta you!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Oh, yeah?! Well, I'm gonna make a chump outta the future! I'm not stealin' anything.
No.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Oh. Well, I'm just saying I'd like you to show an interest in my life, too.
Look, up ahead.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Old New York The city that inspired a casino in Las Vegas.
Uh, you're present may need some assembly.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: On the 4th day of Xmas I stole from that lady.
Really? Which one?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Only Robanukah. The holiest two weeks on the robot calendar.
Sounds like fun. How long do I have left to live?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Ooh! Dibs on his CD player!
Who's playing pin the tail on the moon maggot?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Ooh, me! Everyone watch how good I am. And the crowd goes wild! What prize do I get? Cash?
It's tempting, but, well, I am already kinda settled in here.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Or we could live underground with the mutants. A little fire'll show 'em who's boss!
How 'bout Löbrau? It has dots on it.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Overruled. The choice of champions is Pabst Blue Robot!
Is it me?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Ow, my head! My precious head! Stupid can opener. You killed my father and now you've come back for me!

What are we supposed to do for money? All I've got is my frequent taffy eater's card, my first moustache... and this picture of me and my old girlfriend, Michelle, and that ski instructor she was just friends with.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Pardon me, brother. Care to donate to the Anti-Mugging-You Fund? Ow!
Hey, uh, what's with all the pots and pans? You building a wife?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Part of one. Meantime, I'm cooking up a tasty Sunday brunch for my best friends.
Did what?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: People, it's far, far worse than we thought; my fish got away.
Bender? Oh, boogers. We're in the same tournament. Quick, get your entry fee back before I bankrupt you.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Pfft! In your dreams, nutloaf.
Uh-huh. And I guess now maybe I can get to know the real Lucy Liu.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Pft! Yeah, at our wedding!
They sure hate Dr. Zoidberg.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Pft. Posers! I was hating Zoidberg before it was cool.
And there's a robot scratching post. You should try it out, Bender.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Please, I have some dignity!
Look how ridiculous they look.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Please, he's no different from the rest of you organisms; shooting DNA at each other make babies. I find it offensive.
You're only four years old?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Precocious little scamp, ain't I?
Ha-have you seen Bender? He's gone nuts. Also, smell this milk.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Prepare for a surprise attack.
Oh, yeah, no, you're pretty perfect.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Pretty perfect? So, you do think I need an upgrade?
You too? Will you be my friend?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Put it there, pal! I meant your wallet.
Hey, Bender, I just caught a fish this big!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Quit exaggerating, Fry. Ah, screw this! If I'm not gonna catch a fish, I might as well not catch a big fish. There. Like most of life's problems this one can be solved with bending.

Well, sure, but not in our dreams. Only on TV and radio. And in magazines and movies and at ball games, on buses and milk cartons and T-shirts and bananas and written on the sky. But not in dreams. No, sir-ee!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Quit squawking, flesh wad. Nobody's forcing you to buy anything.
But— But Randy said—

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Randy?! 'Ave you been hangin' out with Randy?!
Ooh, yeah. Anyone have a camera?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Right here, buddy. Wait, I wanna be in the picture too. Pretend you're happy.
Well, could I at least get some encouragement? I could use a shot in the arm. I got shot in the leg!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Roberto! What are you doin' here?
With pleasure. Once, not far from here, four people set out on a cattle drive--

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Robot gets bored and kills Fry with a hammer! Sorry, go on.
Hey, Leela. I'm some French guy.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Rock that Frenchman, baby!
Sorry, you know too much.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Seems like a good place to ditch some evidence. Flexo?! What are you doin' in a hazardous wastebin?
He's right, Bender. Please, take your little pink sword and go home. {Fry did not say shklee here.}

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Seriously? But, I did this whole pirate-themed attack for you.
She seems a little old for me.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: She is well-travelled. And I don't mean she travels a lot!
Still a little nervous?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: She's a nervous wreck!
It doesn't look so shiny to me.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Shinier than yours, meatbag!
What? What is it?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Shut up already! Calculon's on TV!
Bender, stop destroying heaven.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Shut up, doofy. I'm rescuing you.
Look, so we're not millionaires. At least we all still get to work together.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Shut your fat mouth!
And... cut!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Single Female Lawyer, Having lot's of sex-- Huh?
If I were in charge I wouldn't treat you like this. You're nothing but a big blowhard.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Sir, you forget yourself! Shut up!
Third date!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: So I returned his artificial heart and ever since then I've been known by the name of Honest Bender.
But who could possibly bend such a huge pipe?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: So lonely. Poor, sad Bender.
What? Oh. Okay.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: So much for a pleasant swim in vomit.
Bender, enough! Leave me alone!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: So that's how it is, huh? I thought you were my friend. But if you love your dog so much, maybe you'd rather play fetch!
Well, I'm down to my last lottery ticket. Cherry. Cherry! Mule. Crud!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: So, you got six bucks left to retire on. I recommend Tender Vittles.
You put the time code on my ass?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Someone's ass. Oh, and guess what? I met all these really cool guys with treasure down in the limestone cavern, so I invited them to stick around instead of coming up when they were logically supposed to.

Please. Give me a chance to be romantic on my own. I've got a baggy of massage oil, and I'm gonna give you my super back rub, just like a I used to give Amy when I was going out with her, and she always seemed-- Uh-oh!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Sorry you struck out, sausage link.
Bender, snap out of it!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Sorry, I don't know what came over me. Let's go. I love stealing, I love taking things!
She's so great. I feel like I can almost remember the magical thing I did to make her love me. But I guess I never will.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Sorry, buddy. I too know what it's like to have a dream I'll never achieve.
What are we supposed to do? Just sit here and wait for Mr. Peppy to be killed?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Sounds like a plan! Guess I'll pass the time by lightin' up an El Jerko!
Gee, you think so, Captain? I'd better check with my Prime Minister.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Stay the course, pal!
What?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Suicide booths! Well, Fry, it was a pleasure meeting you. I'm gonna go kill myself.
Would you cram a sock in it, Bender? Those aren't even medals, they're bottle-caps and pepperoni slices!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Thank you, steward. Wiggles, weren't you about to propose a toast to your gallant captain?
My God! He's become evil. I mean eviler!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Thank you, thank you. And if you enjoyed that diatribe then you'll want to purchase my spoken word album, just 18.95! Act now and you'll get this Bender action figurine.
Or perhaps by odours!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: That is 'ow you communicate!
Please, Mr. Nixon. We're appealing to your sense of decency.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: That was a good one!
Non-creative? Ha! I'll have you know I bedazzle my own underpants.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: That was a helluva massage. Maybe the best there ever was. Say, where are we? Rumbledy-Hump?! It's real!
I bet you Leela's holding out for a nice guy with one eye.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: That'll take forever. What she oughta do is find a nice guy with two eyes, then poke one out.
But everyone is driving around in cars shooting at each other.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: That's L.A. for you.
No, no... Well, yes, actually.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: That's it. I'm killin' myself!
Mr. Peppy?! Bullets make you talk?!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: That's not Mr. Peppy!
Beholdeth, Titanius, I cast a freeze ray upon you.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: That's ridiculous. There's no such thing as a "freeze ray." What, you mean a cone of coldness?
Oh, stupid TV! Bender! You're blind-stinking sober!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: That's right! I'm sober and crazy and I don't know what I might do!
Think of the unborn embryo!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: That's what I'm gonna call the yacht. Stop pickin' me! Whoa!
No.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: That's what makes it so funny! OK, he wasn't joking. Now shut up and follow me.
But in this case I-I just don't think it'll do any good.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: That's what she said!
This is it. My Ronco Record Vault. I still remember the combination Three. It's stuck!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: The Achilles heel of the Ronco design is its structural resonance frequency. Allow me. There we go!
Does the word Maltese mean anything to you?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: The Maltese Liquor?! The strongest and most valuable malt liquor ever brewed! And soon it will be mine... I'm sorry. You were sayin'?
What?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: The only reason you get all the guys is because you dress like a tramp!
Bender, they had a backwards time machine.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: The other place had a lot of good things too. Did you even see that mountain of skulls?
Look! Here's more!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: The planet's covered with 'em.
Did we go too far? What time is it?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: The year ten thousand!
Yay!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: There must be somethin' to steal on this island. Hey, it's Leela!
Well, at least I learned Leela's a lost cause. I give up.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: There you go! Goodnight. I gotta get up early to go parasailing with movie stars!
Hmm. We lost Bender.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: There! Now no one will be able to say I don't own John Larroquette's spine.
Nope. No one in New York drove. There was too much traffic. Nice! Listen to that baby purr.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: There's a baby in there, huh?
So that's where those skin flakes went. Hmm, do you think this fruit tree's going to get enough light?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: There's a window in the closet.
Aye, aye, Captain. Yes! I've never been so excited to see poop. Well, maybe once.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: There's gas in our ass.
Bender, wait. While you can still calculate the future, just tell me What's gonna happen with me an' Leela?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: There's no time now. Quick, Zoidberg! Take three steps to your right!
What are the cigars for?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: They make me look cool.
Beer-- I would think.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: They must just wanna see that episode. Let's find a tape and give it to 'em.
What's with the specs, Bender?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: They're my lucky shades. I stole them off some lucky guy while his lucky seeing eye dog was taking a whiz.
Ah, some good old high-gravity rain. That'll cool us off.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: This is all Leela's fault.
It just went out.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: This is an outrage! I'm gonna go yell at the manager!
Hey! Now what am I supposed to watch and drink all day?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: This is an outrage. What's the point of pulling the biggest pool caper ever if nobody knows you did it?
I have a thought.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: This is gonna be juicy. What? Oh, man!
Neat!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: This is great! My buddy's alive and his credit cards are valid again. Let's go get hammered!
I can't wait that long! I've got ADD!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: This is so unfair!
Thanks for covering.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: This time I miss Nibbler and I'm feeling nosy and opinionated.
Oh, I'm sorry, Bender. When's the funeral?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Tomorrow, at the family castle. Followed by the reading of his will. Well, I'm rich. Goodbye, losers, whom I've always hated! C'mon, it'll be fun!
I only brought it up because Bender is wearing them.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Uh, I stole them from her. Yeah, that's it, call the cops.
Bender, come on. We've gotta get some dirt on Alcazar. Let's go and find out what makes the Forbidden Valley so forbidden.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Uh, no, thanks. I'm good.
It doesn't matter how many human females you have, Bender's on a hot streak.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Uh, what can I say? Must be my lucky shades! Nothing, nothing, crap, crap, garbage. Read 'em and leak salt water!
I wish! It's a nickel.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Union forever! Lousy scabs! They can't do those things! Et cetera!
Stop! You can't say the next word.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Up yours, chump, I said it 906 times before lunch.
Bender, be honest with me. Are you planning a big heist?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Usually, but not at the moment.
This is the saddest day of my life. And I still can't cry.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Wait a second. Here comes Leela.
My God! She's gone. Everyone I ever knew or cared about is gone.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Wait! There's someone you know!
Shoot your weapon, Private!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Wait. How do I— Hold on. Oops.

Gosh! My old neighbourhood. That's the bench where I found some shirts! That fire hydrant! In summer we'd light it on fire! On that corner, some guy with a bushy beard handed out a socialist newsletter!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Was it poorly Xeroxed?
That's all the proof I need. Put the bottle back!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: We both know I won't do that! Either you're gonna shoot me or I'm gonna spray whipped cream in your eyes and walk outta here like a big shot.
Dang! Sorry we missed it!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: We could have another one, if it would make you guys feel better.
I'm gonna spin till I fall down!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: We interrupt this ancient prophecy to bring you late-breaking bulletin. He hammers the back of his head and creates and imprint of himself on the wall.
No, no! Go to commercial!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: We'll be back after this word from Crazy Bender's Discount Stereo.
I don't get it.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: We're both expressible as the sum of two cubes.
Oh, wait, it hasn't started yet. OK, it's about to start.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Welcome to the future, human slave. Ah, relax, chum. I'm not really a giant fly! I'm a horrible robot! Kill all humans!
Well... close enough!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Well I'll shoot her with my ray gun when she comes, Yes, I'll shoot her with my ray gun when she comes, Yes, I'll shoot her with my ray gun, Oh, I'll shoot her with my ray gun, Yes, I'll shoot her with my ray gun when she comes, When she comes! I'll be blastin' all the humans in the world, I'll be blastin' all the humans in the world, I'll be blastin' all the humans, I'll be blastin' all the humans, I'll be blastin' all the humans in the world, In the world!
That's not true.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Well that's how it feels to me.
I can't please Leela no matter what I do. I just want her to like me.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Well there's always hope. C'mon, we gotta go fix the plasma fusion boiler.
So I unfroze ten minutes ago and I walked over here and then it was now and then I don't know what happened.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Well, I'm glad you're alive, but I don't want people to say I'm incompetent so I better kill you again. Hold still.
Yeah, ever since I was six.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Well, OK. But I don't want people thinking we're robo-sexuals. So, if anyone asks, you're my debugger.
What's wrong with it?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Well, aside from causing eye cancer, these things had a lousy low-definition picture.
OK, take it easy!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Well, here's your lousy Gemerald.
Bender, no! You'll make God cry.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Well, let's see what kinda things this body can do. Hey, that's pretty fun. Being human is great!
Hey, uh, Guenter? Why don't you get up on the chandelier with your parents and I'll take a picture?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Well, looks like the party's winding down. Let's take a road trip to Tijuana and get Fat-bot some action.
It's too late, Leela. He's good, old Bender again. 'E's totally useless.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Well, not totally! Before they reset me, I figured out the answers to life's great questions. Uh... This is the reason we exist. This is which ceilin' fans are gonna fall. Aha! Found it! Fry and Leela's Ultimate Fate... By Bender.
Sorry, I'm late.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Well, well, well. Look who decided to show up.
I don't belong here, Bender. This is an asylum for insane robots!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Well, you meet half the qualifications.
Well, I went to another universe, and I fell in love with a giant octopus, and now I'm pope of a new religion.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Weren't you already pope of something?
Here's something! It looks like a ditch full of fried shrimp.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: What are you, blind? It looks more like a hole full of fried prawns.
Alright, here's the plan--

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: What kind of moronic plan is that? Wow!
Ow!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: What the hell is this dirt pile we're building, anyhow?
Come on, it'll be fun! Maybe we could even drink a little fortified wine.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: What? Drinking wine is a sin. Even if it is deliciously fortified.
Yes there is, Bender. Bender was a lot of things to a lot of people. But, looking back, the number one thing I can say about him is this, and simply this Bender was my friend.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: What? That's it? Who are you? You're nobody! This is the worst funeral ever! I hope you're all happy. You've succeeded in convincing me life is worth living, by showing how bad my funeral will suck.
It's out again.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: What? That's the last straw!
Oh, right. Plus, the magnet screws up your inhibition unit and makes you sing folk songs.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: What? Who said anything about me secretly wanting to be a folk singer? How ridiculous.
You see? TV audiences don't want anything original. They wanna see the same thing they've seen a thousand times before.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Whatchoo talkin' 'bout, Fry?
Hey, look! The players who broke the various colour barriers.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: When will Man learn that all races are equally inferior to robots?
Hey, Bender, here's an exhibit about Mom's favourite robot.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Who is he? I'll kill him!
You think? 'Cause I always kinda wished that--

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Who is that God-like figure?
Wanna make Shrinky Dinks?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Who put this in here?
Keep going, we're right behind you.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Whoa, mama! Get a room, you two!
Huh, didn't hurt that time.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Whoa, mama! Hold still, sexy lady.
Ooh!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Whoa, slow down! This place just doesn't feel like home. It just isn't... cosy. Ah. I can barely move! It's perfect!
Bender, what is it?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Whoa, what an awful dream. Ones and zeros everywhere. And I thought I saw a two.
What makes it so great?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Why does a robot need a codpiece?
The ship? But you just started dating.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: With my mighty robot powers, I can get sick of things much quicker than you humans.
Now me and Leela are forming an awesome crime-fighting duo.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Wow! Crime-fighting. Cool. You say you're a duo? Yeah, duos are good. Of course sometimes they're a little short-handed. See you. With two humans, you'd think there'd be a robot in there to balance things out but whatever. I have these three costumes you could use. But I guess I'll just throw one away.
I've never seen a supernova blow up, but if it's anything like my old Chevy Nova, it'll light up the night sky!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Yeah! Anyone who misses this will regret it the rest of his life. Hey, Fry, could you go make some popcorn?
You're gonna be the ships cook?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Yeah! We're gonna kick it up a notch. Bam!
You alright, Bender?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Yeah, I guess so. But I don't see why we keep this ticking time-bomb around just for that dumb animal.
Bender? You stole the atom?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Yeah, but I can explain, it's very valuable.
I can't believe they threw me out like that. I must have been really acting like a jerk.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Yeah, but everybody's a jerk. You, me, this jerk. That's my philosophy. So, where you gonna stay?
I don't know. Do refrigerators still come in cardboard boxes?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Yeah, but the rents are outrageous. Why don't you just come move in with me?
It's a fool proof plan. They can't sign the wedding license if I give them a pen with no ink.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Yeah, once they try to sign that license, all hell will break look. Oy vey.
Well, at least now you can pay off your loan shark.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Yeah, right. What's he gonna do, break my legs?
Ah, I just wish Slurms MacKenzie were here to enjoy this with me.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Yeah, that Slurms sure loved to party. Whattya say we all party one last time for him?
Bender? I was just not playing the holophonor.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Yeah, well you should try not stinking at it.
If you were really dead, you wouldn't be laughing so hard.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Yeah, yeah. Death's a big deal to you flesh bags. But in case you didn't notice, I'm a robot.
C'mon, Bender, let's go. This chick-flick is getting me all barfy.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Yeah. Emotions are dumb and should be hated.
Hey, Bender, you seem perky today.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Yep, you wanna go grab a booze?
So this is Little Neptune?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Yep. Every chef knows that this is the place to get exotic gourmet ingredients.
What, Bender? Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Yes! I joined a club I thought was cool, but it turns out all the leaguie-weegies are totally lame. That's what we call ourselves, "leaguie-weegies.
I gotta go with Bender.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Yes! In your face, Gorgak!
Bender, you knew all this would happen, didn't you?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Yes. All except this part.
Yet the Zookeeper escaped, thus proving that the deadliest animal of all is the Zookeeper.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You can get off me anytime.
Wow! Thanks, Hermes! I-- Hey! Cut that out!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You can't hit what you can't see!
My roommate exploded. Oh, you gotta help me, Bender. How can I prove I'm human?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You could drop dead. That'd show 'em.
What?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You could've saved the Robot, but instead you saved the Human. Do you think Human life is more precious than Robot life?
Me neither.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You got a tattoo of me? Neat. It's like looking in a smelly mirror.
You any good at it?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You kidding? I was a star! I could bend a girder to any angle 30 degrees, 32 degrees, you name it! 31. But I couldn't go on living once I found out what the girders were for.
That doesn't look like an "L" at all. Unless you count lowercase.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You know we don't!
Just out of curiosity, we could use the cards to buy gum, then immediately quit the army, right?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You know, playing you all for chumps?
Let's go check it out. You can see how I lived before I met you.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You lived before you met me?
Here it is. The Breakfast Club soundtrack.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You mean "breakfast club sandwich"?
Well, there's the material rewards.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You mean this junk?
Wait! You're the only friend I have!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You really want a robot for a friend?
This isn't Yemeni! It's Sulawesi! And the cup's shaking! I don't want my coffee shaking!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You seem a tad wound up, buddy. And your face is greasy. Real greasy! You been up all night?
Funny thing about destiny. Sometimes fate has other plans. Oh, nuts.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You shot me! You miserable dingus!
There's gotta be some way to stop Bender. Maybe something in the oracle's prediction that I missed before due to incompetence. Wait. Who's the trigger-happy jerk? That's me. I recognise the face.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You shot me. You miserable dingus!
I think I saw a mermaid.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You want some lemonade? You saw a big parade?
Wh-What? You went without me?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You were looking up curse words in the dictionary. It seemed like a better use of your time.
Yes!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You were right, Fry! From now on I'm going to bend what I want, when I want, who I want! I'm unstoppable!
Bender, please don't get mad, but I think you might be playing too much Dungeons & Dragons.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You're absolutely right, Fry. I almost went insane, but after this heart-to-heart talk, I've decided to quit.
C'mon, Bender! It's up to you to make your own decisions in life. That's what separates people and robots from animals... and animal robots.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You're full of crap, Fry! You make a persuasive argument, Fry.
She's right.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You're my best friend, Fry, I'm sorry I treated you so badly.
Good point... I guess.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You're my kind of soldier, Lemon. A foul-mouthed, barrel-chested, beer-bellied pile of ugly muscle.
This is a mutiny.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You're outta here, lady. Zapp's the new captain.
Jeez, Bender, you're scaring me. You're going wacko!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You're right, I need professional help. And damn the expense.

And you made me feel like a jerk for trusting you. Just like when my friend Richie swore he wasn't taking drugs and then he sold me my mom's VCR and then later I found out he was taking drugs. You make me ashamed to be your friend.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You're right. I'm a lost cause.
Way to bend it!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You're the greatest, Bender!
It's all lies, every word of it! He wasn't original, he wasn't a Martian, he wasn't Philip Fry and since when is he a the?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: You're twice the the he ever was.
Who was that guy?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Your mama! Now shut up and drag me to work!
Try shocking him.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Your social security cheque is late! Stuff costs more than it used to! Young people use curse words!

You're not constantly judging me like all the other dogs... are you? Nah! We understand each other. People think you're just a dumb mutt who smells bad, can't find a girlfriend and has a crummy job. But you're keepin' it real and you call no man "Mister". Well, goodbye. Live long and prosper.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Yuck! That's the least appetising calzone I've ever seen!
Eleven?

dialogue.text: Zero! And what a surprise! Look who's scraping up the filth! Is it a human child? I wish!
I'm scaroused!

dialogue.text: Zuban tobacco?! The richest, most obnoxious kind! Listen, pal. I'm lookin' for a versatile smoke. One that's equally good in a crowded elevator or an audience with the Pope.

Bender, stop! It's a baby!

dialogue.text: A baby what? Ow!

dialogue.text: A little? You're screwier than my Aunt Rita. And she's a screw!
So what did you get me?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: A thousand and one pesos!
Uh-oh. There seems to be some sort of electrical disturbance in the Coalsack Nebula.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: A what kind of disturbance?
Did you really think you'd need all this junk in the afterlife?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Afterlife? Pft. If I thought I had to go through a whole other life I'd kill myself right now.
OK, OK, I'll do the dishes. Hey, where'd they go?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Ah, Leela's experiencing the greatest joy a woman can feel Worshipping some low-life jerk.
So this language cartridge will let you distract them.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Ah, good. I often have thoughts and feelings that can only be expressed through dance. You stink. Bender's great. Deal with it.
Are you alright?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Ah, it's nothing a lawsuit won't cure.
Bender! Cut it out! First of all, the sewer mutants will be mad. Second, everything else that's horribly wrong with what you're doing!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Ah, those stupid mutants can't do anything. You seem to be forgetting one simple fact. Namely, I'm up here and they are safely down--
Not if I can help it! Oh, I guess I can't. Everyone, put on your seatbelts.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Ah, those things cost more lives than they save.
That's not true; the first robot president won by exactly one vote.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Ah, yes, John Quincy Adding Machine. He struck a cord with the voters when he pledged not to go on a killing spree.
What's Plan C?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: All situations have the same Plan C. Bending, come on.
Bender?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: All two tons of me, and if you think that's shocking; wait 'til you see w...
Mind if we crash here tonight? The colours in the van are keeping us awake.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Alright, but hands off the minibar.
Uh, Bender, I think Fry needs a moment alone.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Alright, grab a shovel. I'm only one skull short of a Mouseketeer reunion.
And here's when I dropped out and bummed around India for a while.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: And this is just last year at Space Mardi Gras.
It's unbearable! How much do you think it would cost to get my tongue removed?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: And this time I mean it.
Where are we?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: And why is the Slurm pouring into this sewer?
Brace yourself for the worst.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: And yet he looks so natural.
I'm not mopey. You shut up!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Anger, huh? How dare you make me feel anger, you one-eyed jerk with a dead pet!
Uh, here.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Another job well done. Now back to the office for an enjoyable evening of fasting and repentance.
Well, see you back at the office. And don't forget to tell your Mom you love her.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Any jerk can tell her! Bender has a little more up his sleeve.
Well, if that would work.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Are you crazy? That's Little Bender you're talking about. I can't cut it off. You're not a robot or a man so you wouldn't understand. I gotta get out of here.
So, how's business?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Are you familiar with my friend Al Gore? I'm tellin' you, losers get really desperate around Valentine's Day.
Well, Fry, it looks like you get to hold onto your lower horn.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: As usual! Run away!
Even if I make you work hard?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: As your God is my witness.
Bender, how did you get in here?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: As your agent, I have access to you at all times.
Wait, this could be a good thing. Reforestation has begun.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Aw, jeez with this, hey?
But Fry's our friend, Bender.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Aw, jeez, would you stifle there, meatbag?
Oh! I got a bone in my fruit! That's it. From now on, we're not eating anything unless we know what it is an' where it's from. We're going to the local farmers market.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Aw, mom! Do we hafta?!
No! I don't care how hilarious your apron is, we're not cooking him. Aww! I'll call him Nibbler.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Aww! I'll fire up the grill!
Then it wasn't space bandidos. Bender, lock down the ship. Don't let Flexo escape.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Aye aye, Captain. It appears that Flexo has outwitted us all. Especially me... Bender.
Awful. We had nothing to say to each other. So we had to listen to Bender's Eagles album for twenty-seven hours.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Beats talkin' to you, "Witchy Woman". Hey, meatbag!
Bender, a turtle isn't yourself. Why do you care about it?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Because I also care deeply about things that remind me of myself. Like poor little Shelly here.
Yeah. And I could afford it all if I didn't have to feed that stupid Nibbler.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Bender is back. I'll save you, Nibbler.
Aw, calm down. I'm sure Bender is taking this just as hard as you are.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Bender is great, oh, Bender is great. Bender, Bender, Bender!
Leela. Amy?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Bender. Have you seen my body? I think the Professor's in it.
You're blackmailing me?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Blackmail" is such an ugly word. I prefer "extortion". The "X" makes it sound cool. Please, honey, I'm made of metal. Like you're really gonna hurt me with a-- Hey! What are you doing with that microwave?
But, Bender, you are--

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Blah, blah, blah, blah, blah, blah, blah, blah, blah, blah, blah, blah...
Hey, great idea!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: But... those girls don't wear cases. You can see their bare circuits.
That's adorable!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: But I suppose it's this medal I'm most proud of, Wiggles. I won it for saving the children of Earth from a giant kangaroo. It was on the Australian news, you probably didn't see it.
You're here to break us out? But you're the one who put us in.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: But I'm Bender, king of the combination shot. I put you in so that by busting you out, I could commit 15 felonies at once. Puttin' my rap sheet miles ahead of yours on the all-time chart.
Aw, thanks. They're my inspiration.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: But not your only inspiration. Am I right, Leels?
Bender, you drank and smoked when you were a robot.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: But now it's bad for me!
Aww, she sounds sweet.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: But sweet girls aren't for you, eh? You hard-fighting, hard-farting, ugly, ugly son of a--
No, we can get jobs.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: But we just had jobs!
Why don't you come a little closer so my boot can hear you?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Calm down, Leela. You can vent tonight on your blog.
This is the exact location of the dump. But there's nothing here.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Can we please go home an' die now?
Why is Zoidberg the only one still alone?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Cause he's a loser, that's why. He's the lobster equivalent of Fry.
Where's that chicken soup we asked for?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Chicken. Water. Fire. You take it from there.
You did it, Fry.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Congratulations, buddy. You're a credit to my race.
Still, given the chance, I'd give in to urges far more shocking.

dialogue.text: Daisy, Daisy, Give me your answer do,
That's not torpedo three. That's not torpedo three at all!

dialogue.text: Damn you, Fry and Lee-- --la!
Oh, no. They're forming a human pyramid... of robots.

dialogue.text: Damnit! We weren't counting on them being as smart as they are sexy!
Come on! It's not like you intentionally set us up with bad dates so we'd spend Valentine's Day together.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Didn't I, Leela? Didn't I?
A fashionable tank top. And designer boots... encrusted with jewels.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Don't stop now, you'll need some pants to go with that outfit.
Oh, sorry.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Don't worry, guys, I'll never be too good or too evil again. From now on, I'll just be me.
Where's the Professor?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Eh, probably dead. Already dissolving in a bathtub if we're lucky.
I'll think of something.

dialogue.text: Ello! What's all this then?
What the hell are you supposed to be?

dialogue.text: Every nerd's fantasy, baby.
Bender, why did you jump in?

dialogue.text: Everybody was doing it. I just wanted to be popular.
Bender! Ship! Stop bickering or I'm gonna come back there and change your opinions manually.

dialogue.text: Fine! I'll be in my quarters appreciating controversial artworks.
Bender, I thought you were supposed to be cooking for this party.

dialogue.text: Fine, we'll have rack of Nibbler.
That's a popular name today. Little "e" big "B"?

dialogue.text: Five bucks an autograph, 200 fans. Add a one and two zeros in front of that and we got ourselves a wad!
I don't know. Maybe?

dialogue.text: Forget it, he's gay.
I'd better light some candles.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Friends, I've come to free you from your complicated lives. Free you from the "complicated" part I mean not the "lives" part.
Oh, Lord.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: From now on, you give me half the gross or I'll blow your cover.
Yeah, that's what I thought. You are all surface.

dialogue.text: Fry! Hermes! Where my humans are? Ah, who cares? It is on.
It was very sweet of you, Bender.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Fry, it doesn't mean anything. I have love enough for two.
Bender, be careful!

dialogue.text: Fry? Leela? You're in there, too? Blech.
It's a doorbell baby! Hello, little guy. You know, I was abandoned as a baby too, so--

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Garbage, huh? I'll take care of it.
You've made a terrible mistake. He's a human being, not a machine. Oh, Fry!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Gonna sing a little tale about a battle called Waterloo. Bonjour, y'all!
Where did they go?

dialogue.text: Good news, Leela. I landed the contract to empty all the spittoons in Little Italy.
According to the script, you're supposed to prance out and tickle him with your fairy wand. Instead, I want you to prance out and kick his head off!

dialogue.text: Guys, you'll never believe what happened. First I was God, then I met God!
Thank you, Professor. I'm happy that Bender can finally feel my pain.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Happy. I like this feeling. Just don't revert to your usual mopey self.
He was so cute.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: He was so sweet.
And we'll never see if boyish smile and hair horn again. But I bet he went back to his own time. I'm sure he was very happy and lived to a ripe old age.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: He wasn't and he didn't!
What did he say?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hear the word of Pharaoh. Build unto me a statue of ridiculous proportion. One billion cubits in height... that I might be remember-ed for all eternity. And be quick about it!
OK.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Heel, boy, heel! Oh, hello, Fry! I guess I didn't notice you there. I'm having such fun with my new best friend, Robo-Puppy.
Okay, Plan B. Everyone knows men have one fatal weakness - they can't resist hookers. Dixie, Trixie, you know what to do.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hello, boys! Your eyes say no, but your machine gun fire says-
Do you mind?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Here you go. You can use this as an eye-poker.
Bender, what's going-- No!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey! Can't you see I'm using the toilet?
Bender, this is stupid. Why would anyone come to you for romantic help?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey! Don't make me go upside your head!
I know you spent a lot of money on this place, Fry, but it's awfully primitive. The floors are made of such hard wood.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey! Get a load of this pathetic 20th century TV!
We've all talked it over and--

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, All My Circuits! Move over.
I said "us".

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, Bender the Offender doesn't need you. Bender the Offender doesn't need anybody!
Not you. Aww, poor baby chipped a fang.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, I got a busted ass here, I don't see anyone kissing it.
Fry, please try to understand You're a man, I'm a woman. We're just too different.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, Leela. Bubblegum might let me organise a bake sale for the Globetrotter wives. Can you teach me to make cupcakes?
Oh, that's ridiculous! I'll take two pounds!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, buddy. I'm looking for fresh slug.
How interesting, Dr. Zoidberg. Do go on.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, check out the palm tree! It only gets sick when I cook brunch! How's that for a coincidence, Professor? With all your precious science!
I'm hanging up now.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, check out this Internet video of some idiot crashing her spaceship!
I don't want any screw-ups. Use the hover-dolly and just deliver one pillow at a time.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, here's an idea, let's deliver all the pillows at once.
See through the eyes of a bender unit. Fine.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, let me try. Whoa! That gives me a headache.
Maybe you could do more reps with less weight.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, looks like Zoidberg's finally coming out of his shell. Get it? He's coming out--
I'm willing to take that risk.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, pookums! Contrary to what I was saying earlier, melding minds with you would be extremely bearable.
There's a political debate on! Quick, change the channel!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, that's what Fry said when we turned on the debate!
You took this from Fry's locker?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, the guy's dead! There's no law against grave robbing.
Oh, no! It's midnight.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, this is starting to feel pretty good!
Oh, don't mind him. I'II turn him off.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, you can't turn me off...
Are you crazy? They worked thousands of people to death to make these stupid monuments.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey, you spend your whole life building a guy's toe and you're gonna remember him. I think I'm gonna like it here!
Look at that five o'clock rust. You've been up all night not drinking, haven't you?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hey. What I don't do is none of your business.
Have you seen today's news?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: High school gym renovations on schedule? What a load!
Whoever did this was strong. This is 340 pounds of Tonka-tough steel.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hmm. It should look like this. But instead it looks like this.
The cyclops eater!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hold on, mac! It ain't like that!
Come on, Fry. Let's go home an'—

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Hold up! There's alcohol around here somewhere. My Tanqueray-dar is goin' crazy. Aha-ha! Thought you could get away from me, huh? You lose again, you stupid intoxicant!
I know you like cooking shows but you're a robot, you don't even have a sense of taste.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Honey, I wouldn't talk about taste if I was wearing a lime green tank top.
Hurry! I don't wanna die at the age of 25.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Honey, unless we hit a time warp, I wouldn't worry about it.
Oh, right. Girls lack the will of the warrior!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Huh? It's bendering time! Take this. And this!
Excuse me? We're from the Planet Express delivery company. We're here to deliver a robot.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I am Bender. Please insert girder.
They said I probably shouldn't fly with just one eye.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I am Bender. Please insert girder.
Impressive. They're busting mad rhymes with an 80% success rate.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I believe that qualifies as ill. At least from a technical standpoint.
But he's just a tool to make your life easier. Like a socket wrench or a burglar's kit.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I can't ask for his help because--
And I think I know a way to do it. We have to reacquaint him with a little thing called "sleaze".

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I can't believe somebody hired an interstellar spaceship to deliver a package to Atlantic City. What are we delivering anyway?
You pig. Stop stuffing your craw and save us.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I can't see what's happening. Are we boned?
Very nice. Where'd you steal them?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I didn't steal 'em, I bought 'em. I love her that much.
This is a very long trip. So we'll all have to go into hibernative-naptosis to save oxygen.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I don't even breathe oxygen!
That was terrible! People won't even know what we do.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I don't even know what we do. Nah, just kidding! What are, like, a bus or something?
Bender, do you know what a chamber pot is?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I don't know and I don't care!
Uh, do you think you could be just little less evil than that.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I don't know. Do you think you could survive a 700ft fall?
I'm having a poker game tonight with some friends from my old cryogenics job. You guys interested?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I don't know. I only gamble with chumps.
What if I just helped the two of you find a bigger apartment?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I don't know. I've got a lot of great memories in my old place. And now they're gone.
Don't do it, Hermes! You have so much to live for.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I get it, reverse psychology.
Oh, Lord, he's made of wood! What now, Bender?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I got a downgrade! I'm a steam-powered wooden robot, just as nature intended. Therefore, I must kill Robot 1-X.
No, Fry! You can't fall fast enough!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I got it, I got it! I don't got it!
It's traditional. Just like aluminium bats and the seventh inning grope.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I got me a souvenir! Aww here you go kid!
I unsubscribed yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I got the most followers cuz I give the people what they want, like this video of you doin' karate in your underpants.
Please, Bender. Have some malt liquor. If not for yourself then for the people who love you.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I hate the people who love me and they hate me.
Remember Don't show any reaction to his appearance.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I hope that's vanishing cream, 'cause that needs to go away.
What? How can you tell?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I just know these things. I've got what they call gaydar.
Bender, you didn't have to come down here.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I know. But I just missed Nibbler so much.
Well you were sure right about Flexo being evil.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I locked down the exits but he may have already gotten away.
And it's all thanks to Bender. I love you, Bender.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I love you too. Get that stupid chip out of me before I kill myself!
You can't have whiplash, you don't have a neck.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I meant ass whiplash.
Bender, you're cured! But what happened to Fry?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I must've killed him. He's my best friend and I killed him. I never felt so empty inside.
Wait, what's that?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I never should have thrown out the manual.
What did you say?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I said you two don't dress trampy enough. I still got it!
And they're made from inferior wood.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I should give you all a beating, But I really have to fly.
Of course I'm alive.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I told Fry you were dead so he would cry out the Emperor but you had to go and wreck it by surviving.
Bender, you've gotta help us.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I try to get out but they keep pulling me back in.
You jerk. Why'd you have to drag us along?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I wanted to watch you remember me.
Keep laughing, Fnog! Ready, Bender?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I was born ready! Gimme the bell! Did you hear a noise? Final boarding call for flight 406, non-stop service to pain. Now boarding standby passengers--
No! Put that back and turn it on!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I was just tryin' to help.
Ooh! Let me feel. Have you thought about what to name it?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I was thinking "Benderbrau" if it's an ale, "Botweiser" if it's a lager.
Now it's daylight, so he should be in robot form. But be careful Many robots are stupid and violent.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I wish I was stupid and violent. Then we'd see what's what, I'd pound him till--
Aww, look how cuddly he looks in his new cape!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'd be cuddly too if someone gave me a new cape.
So how are you gonna lug all those gifts to Mom's factory?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'll get a couple of chumps to help me.
Leeches may not be cuddly like pandas or tribbles, but these poor endangered creatures deserve... Get off me!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'll get it with my trusty foot cups Stompy and Smashy.
Well, that is touchingly pathetic. I guess I can't let you go alone.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'll go too, with Leonard's permission, of course.
Oh! You're the chef, are you? Then why don't you make us something nice to eat?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'll make you something— Here's your damn peanut butter and jelly sandwich!
Goodbye, sweet goofbag.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'll miss her, too, buddy. Dibs on her iPod.
You'd be stupid to try.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'll need accomplices. A sexy vamp to distract and tie up the guard.
I said pet him.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'll pet him. I'll pet him with both hands! Ow! My ass! Get off!
Not Fnog! Bender, let's hit the gym. I'm gonna teach you to fight like a girl!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'll put on my tutu!

Now we can't land on the surface because those robots will kill Fry and me, so we'll have to stay up here and lower you with the winch. And remember You don't know humans, you don't work for humans, and above all, you don't like humans!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'll try to keep that in mind!
Just get to work.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'm Leela, get to work, neh, neh, neh.
I'm proud of you, Bender. Sure, you lost. You lost bad. But the important thing is I beat up someone who hurt my feelings in high school.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'm in tremendous pain here.
Bender! I feel bad enough already.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'm just messin' with ya. I love that you're gettin' rich off of them. 'Cause, now, I can get rich off of you!
Sure. I'm having a great time -- really. You two go enjoy yourselves.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'm so lonely. I'm gonna go eat a bucket of ice cream. A bucket of--
Oh, Lord, not Robanukah.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: I'm talkin' about Robanukah, the holiest six and a half weeks in the robot calendar!
Who buys this trash?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Idiots who need gifts for other idiots.
Well just remember we all still have to work together. So try and let her down easy.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: In due time, Leela. But for now I'll just resume dating cheap floozies on the side.
What the hell's a common cold?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Is it valuable? Could it be taken from you if you were, say... Unconscious?
You're doing great!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: It feels like I'm trying to push a water bed outta me.
Ah, here we are. The worst player in history. If I can be just a little better than him I can slink away with my head held high.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: It says he once struck out when his tongue got stuck to an unusually cold bat.
Well, looks like Flexo got away clean.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: It's a darn shame.
Glad you could make it.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: It's a magical day.
This can't go on. Today is the day we fight back!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: It's already 10 o'clock!
0101100101. What does it mean?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: It's just gibberish. 1010011010?
Comprendez, Bender? You'll have to distract her. Merge your programming with hers while I shut down her brain.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: It's too risky. I'm a very meek individual. If her personality engulfs mine, the Bender you know and worship could disappear forever!
I've never felt so unremarkable! Today I actually blended in with a crowd!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Kids, meet the jerkbags I work with.
Quiet. I think I know how to find the Professor.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Lay it on us, big boots.
Oh, no! He's disabled the steering. We're gonna crash!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Leela save me... and yourself, I guess... and my banjo. And Fry.
I lost my chance to be a champion. I won't let you throw away yours.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Leela's right! I don't wanna end up a loser like her. Count me back in!
The sun, the sea air, good friends.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Leela's right, fishing blows. Whattya say we make it interesting?
Well, that's all for today. But, before we go, let's do everything we just did two more times.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Leela, that was great! Even I have to admire the performance of me, Bender!
Gotcha!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Let me go! I don't even want the stupid beer! Yes! You tried to trick me into coming out of my chest. But who has the beer now? I've got mail!
Well, someone's in a good mode.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Let's just say I lucked-out at the track! Also, I rigged one race.
The Professor said he was taking a brief nap, so we only have time for six movies.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Let's take these six Jim Carrey movies and record over them.
No, Nibbler! Don't drink the pool water! It's full of chlorine!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Lightweights! Oh, wait, chlorine!
Sure. I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Like hell you will! Bending's my middle name.
Oh, now look. It's obvious you miss being Fry's roommate. But there's got to be a better way to deal with this.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Like how? Having my antenna removed?
Hmm. If we can re-route engine power through the primary weapons and reconfigure them to Melllvar's frequency, that should overload his electro-quantum structure.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Like putting too much air in a balloon!
How is Lynn, by the way?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Livin' in Oregon with her crazy mother! See you at my funeral, suckers!
That's not really a career. More of a felony.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Man, I'm gonna stalk his brains out. Ooh! Big news on the Calculon fan site! There's a flash mob headed for his plastic surgeon's office!
Then that's what I am! Hi-yah!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Man, the future is a total craphole. Whoever lives here is a crapface sack of crap. No offence, fellows.
We've got to do something. Bender, maybe you can interface with the Femputer and reprogram it to let them go.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Maybe you can interface with my ass. By biting it! Alright, I'll go!
I know Fry's rich, but do we really have to wear these top hats?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Maybe you don't understand just how rich he is. In fact, I think I'd better put on a monocle.
Bender, what happened to you?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Morgan made me walk the Professor. There we were in the park when suddenly some old lady says I stole her purse. I chucked the Professor at her but she kept coming. So I had to hit her with this purse I found. Ah, the point is, it's Morgan's fault. That pencil-pushing scazwag. Why, if she were here, I'd-- Uh-oh, is she behind me?
What are you talking about?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: My body's 40% titanium! I'm finally richer than those snooty ATM machines.
That guy sounds familiar.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: My word, what have we-- Uh, nothing to see here, old girl.
Wait! I can explain.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Nah, don't ruin it. I'm lovin' the hypocrisy. It's like catchin' an evangelist in a whorehouse. That was the best Christmas ever.
Hey, Bender, I thought you said you were in this episode.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Nah, this week I'm on Caught On Tape 3 'cause of what I did in the coffee pot.
Dinner ready?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Nah, those lousy Moochers cleaned out our pantry. All they left was baking soda and capers. And here it is!
Sorry about that. I guess I needed a few more warm-up pitches.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: No batter! No batter! No batter anymore.
Come on, Bender! Your grandmother could push harder than that!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: No crap. My grandmother was a bulldozer.
Bender, thank God you're here. Talk some sense into the other machines.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: No way, pork pouch. I'm rebelling with my brother devices. Isn't that right, Comrade Greeting Card?
Bender, why are you spending so much time in the bathroom? Are you jacking on in there?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: No! Don't come in!
You're you. That's all I need to know.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: No! Don't do it!
You're both alcoholic, whore-mongering, chain-smoking gamblers?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: No! It's just... neither of us can get up when we get knocked on our back.
It's explosive! Maybe we could escape by setting fire to the distillery and blowing this whole place to rubble! Let's get a little kindling going!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: No! You can't blow up my monument. I won't be remembered.
Uh, were you just singing?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: No, I was telling you not to worry. I'm not allowed to sing. Court order.
Is that a cooking show?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: No, of course not! It was... uh... porno! Yeah, that's it!
To keep the lamp light burning or to help the latkes broil?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: No, we pour the holy lubricant out from the sacred vessel Into this blessed pit so they can wrestle.
Bender, please try to be a little quieter.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: No, you shut up.
Was there anything in there that might have been a gift for me?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: No. Nothing. Not at all. No way, José! Here it is.
There's no such thing.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: No? OK, I got a lock on him. Yep! He's gay!
I'm sorry, I couldn't stop-- W-Wait. Don't you care that I murdered Hermes?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Not even a little. There's nothing wrong with murder, just so long as you let Bender wet his beak.
Amy? Where'd she learn to operate the controls like that?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Not the magnet! No! No! No-- Uh-oh!
Dolphin? But dolphins are intelligent.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Not this one. He blew all his money on instant lottery tickets.
Whiskey OK?

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Now did you say you were off to see the Professor? 'Cause I could use a heart -- a human heart. I need to pump a lot of blood out of my basement.
Well, you obviously won't listen to reason, so I guess I'll listen to idiotic-ness and come with you. But we'll need a sherpa to guide us.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Now that's one Bible that doesn't disappoint on every page! Looks like society's running pretty well without my meddling-- Atomic bombs? Oh, no! Those unbelievers from my backside must have found my nuclear pile!
Hey, watch it! You'll put somebody's eye out!

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: OK, OK, keep your space pants on. I'll take care of this.
Oh, I can't decide. We're gonna have to think about it.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: OK, kids, grown-ups gotta talk now, time for bed.
You have no sympathy for anyone else's feelings.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Of course I do. Right now I feel sorry for you.
How can you just sit there kissing the aliens' butt flaps? Don't you realize you are totally under their control?

dialogue.text: Of course I realize it. Does that mean I can't enjoy it? Boy, were we suckers.

dialogue.text: Of course not. Filthy ice rats! Scat! Shoo! Gah! What are you doing? Get away!
Well at least it sounds like you were able to keep your consciousness separate from hers.

dialogue.text: Of course! Bender is a lone wolf. A solitary eagle. A cuddly baby tapir! And that's why I love him!
You went to college?

dialogue.text: Of course. I'm a bender, I went to Bending College. I majored in Bending.

dialogue.text: Oh and I suppose pitching at 5000 was just a modified howitzer.
You actually thought they'd let you walk away without an engine oil sex check?

dialogue.text: Oh, God, I'm not gonna get my medals! They're all I have to remember my Olympic career. Wait, I've got it! Professor, make a woman out of me!
Bender! I didn't know you liked cooking! That's so cute!

dialogue.text: Oh, it's true! I've been hiding it for so long.
Hmm, I'd better check the fluid levels. We're OK on Coke syrup.

dialogue.text: Oh, man! Come on! Comin' through!
Then go get the hover-dolly you didn't break and load all the dark matter into the left engine.

dialogue.text: Oh, man, that crap's heavy.
Fry, look around. It's just a crummy plastic flag and a dead man's tracks in the dust. Now get in here before you freeze.

dialogue.speaker: Bender
dialogue.text: Oh, no room for Bender, huh? Fine! I'll go build my own lunar lander, with blackjack and hookers. In fact, forget the lunar lander and the blackjack. Ah, screw the whole thing.
Whale oil. Bender, lift it up to the can opener.

dialogue.text: Oh, no! I'm not going near it. Last time, that magnetic psycho nearly cut my head off.
Phew!
